description-proc.ces: ZAITRA requests proposals from space infrastructure providers (Satellite as a Service providers) to host the SKAISEN edge computing software on-board a spacecraft for about 15-month operational validation. The objective is to validate the end-to-end service (from sensor acquisition to real-time insights delivered to the end user) across multiple user-provided Areas of Interest (AoIs). SKAISEN requires access to an optical camera with ≤ 2 m GSD at 500km (2 meter or better). Multispectral bands are desirable but optional. ZAITRA žádá poskytovatele vesmírné infrastruktury (poskytovatele satelitů jako služby) o předložení nabídek na hostování softwaru SKAISEN edge computing na palubě kosmické lodi po dobu přibližně 15 měsíců. Cílem je ověřit komplexní službu (od snímání dat ze senzorů až po informace v reálném čase poskytované koncovému uživateli) napříč několika uživatelsky dostupnými oblastmi zájmu (AoI). SKAISEN vyžaduje přístup k optické kameře s GSD ≤ 2 m na vzdálenost 500 km (2 metry nebo lepší). Multispektrální pásma jsou žádoucí, ale volitelná.

title-proc.dan: Swath scanning laser altimeter
title-proc.eng: Swath scanning laser altimeter

dan: DTU Space er meget involveret i ESA’s luftbårne satellitkalibrerings- og valideringskampagner i polarområder. For at sikre, at DTU Space's instrumentpakke lever op til behovene for validering af nuværende ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2 og for at udnytte præcisionen af fremtidige dobbeltfrekvente satellitmissioner (såsom Copernicus højprioritet kandidatmission CRISTAL) er det vigtigt at købe en laser scanner, der kan måle i højde og områder. Laserscanneren skal være et kompakt system tilpasset et mellemstort fly og i stand til at måle overfladen af havis, landis og havvand. Da laserscannersystemet vil blive brugt sammen med luftbårne radarhøjdemålere, skal laserscanneren som minimum kunne betjenes inden for områder på 300-1000 m for reflekterende mål på ≥ 10 %. Købet er en vital del af det nationalt finansierede projekt Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) og bidrager til udviklingen af en ny forskningsinfrastruktur, der giver et meget påkrævet vedvarende og langsigtet observationsnetværk af det centrale klima omkring Grønland, der ikke kun repræsenterer hele Grønland, men også en klimagradient, der repræsenterer Arktis som helhed.
eng: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

title-proc.eng: Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland

eng: DMI monitors and reports routinely on sea ice and iceberg conditions near shore and inshore in South Greenland for direct support and guidance of local shipping. The suite of local ships ranges from com-mercial, passenger and coast guard ships to small individual and sail boats. The occurrence of sea ice and icebergs is a hazard or obstacle to local shipping. It has been procedure for years to notify local shipping about difficult ice before they actually enter such areas so appropriate bridge decisions can made. The primary area of interest is within 59°45’N-62°00N and 42°50’W-48°30’W. The standard products based on the helicopter recce are the following: - Ice report in plain language - Photo series of ice conditions at selected or critical positions or annotated satellite imagery. Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable.

description-proc.eng: DMI monitors and reports routinely on sea ice and iceberg conditions near shore and inshore in South Greenland for direct support and guidance of local shipping. The suite of local ships ranges from com-mercial, passenger and coast guard ships to small individual and sail boats. The occurrence of sea ice and icebergs is a hazard or obstacle to local shipping. It has been procedure for years to notify local shipping about difficult ice before they actually enter such areas so appropriate bridge decisions can made. The primary area of interest is within 59°45’N-62°00N and 42°50’W-48°30’W. The standard products based on the helicopter recce are the following: - Ice report in plain language - Photo series of ice conditions at selected or critical positions or annotated satellite imagery. Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable.

title-proc.eng: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program

eng: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

title-proc.dan: GPS-trackingsystem med tilhørende udstyr samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling og rådgivning.

dan: Banedanmark har et GPS-trackingsystem, der anvendes til dels at effektivisere processer omkring lokalisering af rullende jernbanemateriel, tjenestebiler samt andet materiel og samtidig optimere dannelse af kørebogsdata for tjenestebiler og driftstimeregnskab/logbog for motoriseret rullende jernbanemateriel. Derudover er systemet brugt til at nedbringe uautoriseret og uanmeldt anvendelse af Banedanmarks materiel. Banedanmarks nuværende kontrakt på GPS-trackingsystem udløber snart, hvorfor Banedanmark med dette udbud på ny ønsker at indkøbe et GPS-trackingsystem til at understøtte samme formål som i dag samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling af det udbudte samt rådgivning. Herudover skal udstyret udskiftes, så Banedanmark ønsker at indkøbe nyt tilhørende udstyr (GPS’er) til alt materiellet. Systemet skal kunne understøtte anvendelsen af forskellige typer materiel (”rullende jernbanemateriel”, ”tjenestebiler” og ”andet materiel”), og materiellet skal være udstyret med mobile enheder (bestående af en GPS-enhed, batteri og ID-kort), der løbende via GSM-nettet sender besked til det centrale GPS-trackingsystem. Det centrale system skal leveres med en rapporteringsløsning, en administrationsgrænseflade, en grafisk grænseflade, der kan vise materiellets position på et kort samt en grænseflade rettet mod teknikere, der anvender en mobil enhed. Leverandøren skal levere udstyret til Banedanmark. Leverandøren skal forestå installation af GPS’er i tjenestebilerne i Banedanmarks bilpark, der er på over 100 biler. Banedanmark forestår selv installation af udstyret i Banedanmarks rullende materiel og øvrige materiel. description-proc.dan: Banedanmark har et GPS-trackingsystem, der anvendes til dels at effektivisere processer omkring lokalisering af rullende jernbanemateriel, tjenestebiler samt andet materiel og samtidig optimere dannelse af kørebogsdata for tjenestebiler og driftstimeregnskab/logbog for motoriseret rullende jernbanemateriel. Derudover er systemet brugt til at nedbringe uautoriseret og uanmeldt anvendelse af Banedanmarks materiel. Banedanmarks nuværende kontrakt på GPS-trackingsystem udløber snart, hvorfor Banedanmark med dette udbud på ny ønsker at indkøbe et GPS-trackingsystem til at understøtte samme formål som i dag samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling af det udbudte samt rådgivning. Herudover skal udstyret udskiftes, så Banedanmark ønsker at indkøbe nyt tilhørende udstyr (GPS’er) til alt materiellet. Systemet skal kunne understøtte anvendelsen af forskellige typer materiel (”rullende jernbanemateriel”, ”tjenestebiler” og ”andet materiel”), og materiellet skal være udstyret med mobile enheder (bestående af en GPS-enhed, batteri og ID-kort), der løbende via GSM-nettet sender besked til det centrale GPS-trackingsystem. Det centrale system skal leveres med en rapporteringsløsning, en administrationsgrænseflade, en grafisk grænseflade, der kan vise materiellets position på et kort samt en grænseflade rettet mod teknikere, der anvender en mobil enhed. title-proc.dan: Swath scanning laser altimeter
title-proc.eng: Swath scanning laser altimeter

dan: DTU Space er meget involveret i ESA’s luftbårne satellitkalibrerings- og valideringskampagner i polarområder. For at sikre, at DTU Space's instrumentpakke lever op til behovene for validering af nuværende ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2 og for at udnytte præcisionen af fremtidige dobbeltfrekvente satellitmissioner (såsom Copernicus højprioritet kandidatmission CRISTAL) er det vigtigt at købe en laser scanner, der kan måle i højde og områder. Laserscanneren skal være et kompakt system tilpasset et mellemstort fly og i stand til at måle overfladen af havis, landis og havvand. Da laserscannersystemet vil blive brugt sammen med luftbårne radarhøjdemålere, skal laserscanneren som minimum kunne betjenes inden for områder på 300-1000 m for reflekterende mål på ≥ 10 %. Købet er en vital del af det nationalt finansierede projekt Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) og bidrager til udviklingen af en ny forskningsinfrastruktur, der giver et meget påkrævet vedvarende og langsigtet observationsnetværk af det centrale klima omkring Grønland, der ikke kun repræsenterer hele Grønland, men også en klimagradient, der repræsenterer Arktis som helhed.
eng: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

title-proc.eng: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program

eng: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

title-proc.dan: Swath scanning laser altimeter
title-proc.eng: Swath scanning laser altimeter

dan: DTU Space er meget involveret i ESA’s luftbårne satellitkalibrerings- og valideringskampagner i polarområder. For at sikre, at DTU Space's instrumentpakke lever op til behovene for validering af nuværende ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2 og for at udnytte præcisionen af fremtidige dobbeltfrekvente satellitmissioner (såsom Copernicus højprioritet kandidatmission CRISTAL) er det vigtigt at købe en laser scanner, der kan måle i højde og områder. Laserscanneren skal være et kompakt system tilpasset et mellemstort fly og i stand til at måle overfladen af havis, landis og havvand. Da laserscannersystemet vil blive brugt sammen med luftbårne radarhøjdemålere, skal laserscanneren som minimum kunne betjenes inden for områder på 300-1000 m for reflekterende mål på ≥ 10 %. Købet er en vital del af det nationalt finansierede projekt Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) og bidrager til udviklingen af en ny forskningsinfrastruktur, der giver et meget påkrævet vedvarende og langsigtet observationsnetværk af det centrale klima omkring Grønland, der ikke kun repræsenterer hele Grønland, men også en klimagradient, der repræsenterer Arktis som helhed.
eng: DTU Space is heavily involved in ESA’s airborne satellite calibration and validation campaigns in polar regions. To secure the DTU Space instrument package is living up to the needs for validation of current (ESA CryoSat, NASA ICESat-2) and to exploit the precision of future dual-frequency satellite missions (such as Copernicus high-priority candidate mission CRISTAL) it is of vital importance to purchase a swath scanning laser altimeter. The laser altimeter shall be a compact system adapted to a mid-sized aircraft and capable of measuring the surface of sea ice, land ice and ocean water. As the laser scanner system will be used together with airborne radar altimeters, the laser scanner shall, as a minimum, be operable within ranges of 300-1000 m for reflective targets of ≥ 10%. The purchase is a vital part of the nationally funded project Greenland Integrated Observing System (GIOS) and contributes to the development of a new research infrastructure providing a much-required sustained and long-term observation network of the central climate around Greenland representing not only entire Greenland but also a climate gradient representing the Arctic as a whole.

dan: Sund & Bælt har 25 års erfaring med opkrævning af vejafgifter,herunder opkrævning i betalingsanlægget på Storebælt. Sund & Bælt har etableret en særskilt Tolling division, som varetager opgaver med at designe, udvikle, implementere og drifte vejafgiftsløsningen for koncernen og for Staten. Med årene er flere afgiftsopgaver og lignende opgaver kommet til: 1. I 2019 implementerede Sund & Bælt Danmarks første Free Flow betalingsanlæg på Frederikssundsforbindelsen 2. I 2020 implementerede Sund & Bælt digital håndhævelse af miljøzoner i Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Frederiksberg og København 3. I december 2020 blev der indgået politisk aftale om at indføre vejafgifter for lastbiler i Danmark fra 1. januar 2025 4. I samme politiske aftale blev det besluttet at gennemføre et forsøg med vejafgifter for personbiler fra 2023 til 2025 5. I 2029 åbner den ny Femern-forbindelse, hvor der skal stå et nyt betalingsanlæg klar til at opkræve vejafgifter for kørsel over forbindelsen. Målet er at Storebælt og Femern har ens betalingsanlæg, så der er etableret et projekt med udarbejdelse af udbudsmateriale til offentliggørelse ultimo 2024 P.t. er der således tre igangværende projekter: 6. Gennemførelse af forsøg med vejafgifter for personbiler 7. Implementering af vejafgifter for lastbiler 8. Anskaffelse af betalingsanlæg til Storebælt og Femern Sund & Bælt har behov for konsulentbistand i form af faglige specialister vedrørende implementering af vejafgifter, herunder vejbetalingsanlæg, som blandt andet kan bistå med: >Teknisk design af Enforcement løsninger (håndhævelse) og Collection løsninger (opkrævning), >Teknisk viden om kontrolløsninger, Kameraovervågningsløsninger, billedvalideringsløsninger, teknologier som ANPR, DSRC, GNSS, vejbetalingsanlæg >Bistand til implementering af førnævnte løsninger >Erfaring med definition og implementering af forretningsprocesser der understøtter ovenstående, samt erfaring med projektledelse i relation til vejafgiftsordninger

description-proc.dan: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- & Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) planlægger at udbyde en rammeaftale som skal dække Forsvarets behov for civile GPS på fire år. Aftalen vil bl.a. indeholde GPS til personvogne, lastvogne (indvendig montering) og Motorcykel, som også kan anvendes til PMV, ATV, snescootere og hundeslæde (udvendig montering). Derudover vil der også være behov for håndholdte GPS m/u nødsender funktion, håndledsbårne GPS og GPS til træning og håndtering af hunde. Der forventes at være behov for standardtilbehør såsom antenner, holdere, strømforsyninger m.v. FMI ønsker at få et dybdegående kendskab til markedet for civile GPS, for at kunne planlægge et kommende udbud bedst muligt.

description-proc.dan: Vejdirektoratet gennemfører en høring af udbudsmaterialet på kommende udbud på FCD Point Data and FCD Segment Data til statistisk brug som grundlag for fremtidig analyse af trafikforhold f.eks. til beslutningstagning og planlægning. Dette kræver levering af FCD Segment Data, der dækker alle statsveje i Danmark samt kommunale veje forbundet med det statslige vejnet og større rampeforbindelser. Data skal primært bruges sammen med en række eksisterende softwaresystemer til trafikale analyser og planlægningsformål. I øjeblikket forventer Vejdirektoratet, at det kommende udbud vil have følgende leverancer: • Rå tidsstemplede GPS/GNSS-punktdata. • Hastigheder på et segmenteret vejnet, hvor hastighederne er baseret på map-matchede GPS/GNSS-data.
description-proc.eng: The Danish Road Directorate (Vejdirektoratet) conducts a hearing of the tender material for future tender for FCD Point Data and FCD Segment Data for statistical use as a basis for future analysis of traffic conditions e.g. for decision-making and planning. This requires delivery of FCD Segment Data covering all state roads in Denmark as well as municipal roads connected to the state road network and major ramp connections. The FCD is to be used primarily with several existing software systems for traffic analysis and planning purposes. Currently the The Danish Road Directorate expects the upcoming procurement will have the following deliveries: • Raw time stamped GPS/GNSS point data. • Aggregated vehicle speeds distributed over a segment road network, where speeds are based on map-matched GPS/GNSS data

title-proc.dan: GPS-trackingsystem med tilhørende udstyr samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling og rådgivning.

dan: Banedanmark har et GPS-trackingsystem, der anvendes til dels at effektivisere processer omkring lokalisering af rullende jernbanemateriel, tjenestebiler samt andet materiel og samtidig optimere dannelse af kørebogsdata for tjenestebiler og driftstimeregnskab/logbog for motoriseret rullende jernbanemateriel. Derudover er systemet brugt til at nedbringe uautoriseret og uanmeldt anvendelse af Banedanmarks materiel. Banedanmarks nuværende kontrakt på GPS-trackingsystem udløber snart, hvorfor Banedanmark med dette udbud på ny ønsker at indkøbe et GPS-trackingsystem til at understøtte samme formål som i dag samt implementering, drift, vedligehold, support, tilpasning/udvikling af det udbudte samt rådgivning. Herudover skal udstyret udskiftes, så Banedanmark ønsker at indkøbe nyt tilhørende udstyr (GPS’er) til alt materiellet. Leverandøren skal levere udstyret til Banedanmark. Leverandøren skal forestå installation af GPS’er i tjenestebilerne i Banedanmarks bilpark, der er på over 100 biler. Banedanmark forestår selv installation af udstyret i Banedanmarks rullende materiel og øvrige materiel. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet, herunder især Bilag 2 Kravspecifikation for yderligere information om de af udbuddet omfattede opgaver. Kontrakten løber fra underskrift og 4 år frem. Der henvises til kontraktens § 34. Kontrakten kan forlænges i 2 x 2 år. Kontraktens værdi er estimeret til 8 mio. kr. for 8 år (4 år + 2 år + 2 år).

title-proc.eng: Satellite imagery for in-shore ice analysis in Greenland

eng: DMI monitors and reports routinely on sea ice and iceberg conditions near shore and inshore in South Greenland for direct support and guidance of local shipping. The suite of local ships ranges from com-mercial, passenger and coast guard ships to small individual and sail boats. The occurrence of sea ice and icebergs is a hazard or obstacle to local shipping. It has been procedure for years to notify local shipping about difficult ice before they actually enter such areas so appropriate bridge decisions can made. The primary area of interest is within 59°45’N-62°00N and 42°50’W-48°30’W. The standard products based on the helicopter recce are the following: - Ice report in plain language - Photo series of ice conditions at selected or critical positions or annotated satellite imagery. Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable.

title-proc.dan: Rammeaftale vedrørende levering af sporingssystem og tilhørende sporingsenheder til Aalborg Kommunes plejehjem

dan: Aalborg Kommune udbød ved udbudsbekendtgørelse nr. 2023/S 132-419489 en rammeaftale på levering af sporingssystem og tilhørende sporingsenheder til plejehjem i Aalborg Kommune. Leverandøren skal under rammeaftalen levere et web- og app-baseret sporings- og administrationssystem til Aalborg Kommune samt tilhørende sporingsenheder til visiterede borgere i kommunen. Rammeaftalen indeholder endvidere løbende support og vedligeholdelse i relation til det leverede sporingssystem. Rammeaftalen blev udbudt i to modeller med sideordnede bud, hvorved der kunne bydes på levering af sporingssystemet og de tilhørende sporingsenheder ved en købs- og/eller en leasing-model (ift. sporingsenheder og tilhørende hardware mv).
Aalborg Kommune

description-proc.dan: Aalborg Kommune udbød ved udbudsbekendtgørelse nr. 2023/S 132-419489 en rammeaftale på levering af sporingssystem og tilhørende sporingsenheder til plejehjem i Aalborg Kommune. Leverandøren skal under rammeaftalen levere et web- og app-baseret sporings- og administrationssystem til Aalborg Kommune samt tilhørende sporingsenheder til visiterede borgere i kommunen. Rammeaftalen indeholder endvidere løbende support og vedligeholdelse i relation til det leverede sporingssystem. Rammeaftalen blev udbudt i to modeller med sideordnede bud, hvorved der kunne bydes på levering af sporingssystemet og de tilhørende sporingsenheder ved en købs- og/eller en leasing-model (ift. sporingsenheder og tilhørende hardware mv).

title-proc.dan: Civil GPS til Forsvaret

dan: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- & Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) planlægger at udbyde en rammeaftale som skal dække Forsvarets behov for civile GPS på fire år. Aftalen vil bl.a. indeholde GPS til personvogne, lastvogne (indvendig montering) og Motorcykel, som også kan anvendes til PMV, ATV, snescootere og hundeslæde (udvendig montering). Derudover vil der også være behov for håndholdte GPS m/u nødsender funktion, håndledsbårne GPS og GPS til træning og håndtering af hunde. Der forventes at være behov for standardtilbehør såsom antenner, holdere, strømforsyninger m.v. FMI ønsker at få et dybdegående kendskab til markedet for civile GPS, for at kunne planlægge et kommende udbud bedst muligt.
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation

title-proc.eng: Autonomous floats for the ARGO program

eng: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

description-proc.eng: Argo is a global real-time ocean observing network with a fleet of autonomous floats measuring the properties of seawater and sending data in real time via satellite communications. The floats can regu-late their buoyancy and therefore collect measurements of profiles of water properties. This makes them unique compared to other sustained observation systems which measure only at fixed depths (buoys or remote sensing). The program represents a fleet of about 4000 autonomous floats, deployed all over the world ocean. They carry an array of sensors with the core being temperature, and salinity, while other sensors are often added to cover other parameters such as dissolved oxygen, phytoplankton fluorescence, or-ganic matter fluorescence, nitrate, particle scattering and irradiance. The data is made freely available to all via coordinated global ARGO data centers. Just as weather balloons provide profiles of atmos-pheric conditions for weather forecasting, the ARGO program delivers ocean properties for monitor-ing and forecasting ocean conditions (operational modelling) and also supporting climate research and modelling. Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has initiated Denmark participation in ARGO via a Research in-frastructure grant from the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. The initiative has now been tak-en over by Danish Centre for Marine Research (DCMR), the secretariate of which is at DTU. DCMR is a national virtual centre funded by the national budget, with representation from all institutions in-volved in marine research in the Kingdom of Denmark.

title-proc.eng: Copenhagen Metro – Future O&M contract

eng: The O&M contract is expected to include the following services etc. and have the following characteristics: The lines encompassed by the tender span over 44 stations (30 underground stations and 14 above ground stations) and approximately 40 kilometers doubletrack in the Copenhagen area. The metro system operates 24/7 with a varying headway throughout the day. Currently, the metro has approximately 2 million passengers per week on average. This figure is expected to increase in the coming years. The metro is a fully automated and driverless, GoA4 system, it consists of two separated systems; M1/M2 and M3/M4 each with own control and maintenance centre and is operated without any operator staff (e.g. stewards) on the trains. The assets, which are owned by Metroselskabet and are made available to the operator, include e.g. • Tunnels and structures, including stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts, bridges and embankments • Railway infrastructure, including power supply, traction power, permanent way, ATC system, platform screen doors, automatic platform gates, passenger security and information systems, SCADA, access control systems and intrusion detection systems, radio communication systems and transmission systems, passenger-counting system, and the equipment related to the Rejsekort (travel card) system and ticketing system • Electrical and mechanical installations and equipment in tunnels, structures, stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts and CMC, including ventilation • Passenger vehicles and service vehicles • Escalators • Control and Maintenance Center, including outdoor areas • Documentation, manuals and procedures • IT systems and programmes forming part of the metro system • Certain management systems • Movables • Consumables (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) • Spare parts (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) The winning tenderer (the O&M Provider) is expected to be entrusted with the full responsibility for the daily operation and the majority of the maintenance of assets forming part of the metro system, including provision of spare parts and consumables. The O&M Provider’s services, tasks, etc. under the O&M contract are, on an overall level, expected to include, but not be limited to: - Traffic operations, including operation of traffic systems and staffing. - Passenger services, e.g. traffic information and customer service. - Maintenance of assets, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, provision of spare parts, cleaning, maintenance optimisation, etc. - Information technology services, including cyber security. - Data management. - Ticketing and passenger counting. - Communication and marketing, via e.g. websites, based on communication plans and strategies. - Organisation and management services, e.g. quality management, configuration management, obsolescence management, environmental management, security and resilience management, railway safety management and human resource management. - Reporting, planning, documentation, etc., including e.g. delivery of various reports at certain intervals, provision of other information, and compilation, updating and maintenance of documentation. - Services in the mobilisation phase and in connection with the expiry of the O&M contract, including certain transitional services to assist in the mobilisation of a potential new O&M Provider. In addition, the O&M Provider is expected to perform additional tasks and projects in relation to the metro system, e.g. development / improvement of assets, on an optional basis. Furthermore, the O&M Provider is expected to participate in and provide services / deliverables in relation to a number of larger investment / reinvestment projects and other third-party projects in relation to the metro system during the O&M contract period that are expected to be subject to separate procurements / contracts. These projects are expected to include replacement of rolling stock and signalling for the M1 and M2 lines. The contract length is expected to be 12 years with one or more options for extension for a total of 3 years. Payment under the contract is expected to be in the form of operation and maintenance fees (with the addition or deduction of incentive amounts) and e.g. payments for options and variations. Metroselskabet will retain all ticket revenues. The specific scope and terms of the O&M contract may be subject to changes prior to announcement of the tender and during the tender phase based on Metroselskabet’s further assessment and the potential market input to the tender.

description-proc.dan: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Miljøministeriet, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stakke- og stokeffekter ved skovveje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data som gør, at rundtræs-takke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift). Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen skal danne grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

title-proc.eng: Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM

eng: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is executing a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation

The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.

description-proc.eng: Copenhagen Metro is inviting to participation in a market dialogue with potential interested contractors with interest in a dialogue regarding the construction of a new metro line in Copenhagen. The new line could be approx. 15.7 km long standalone metro line with up to 10 stations, some underground and some elevated. Some stations and part of the line will be underground in existing dense city environment and some will be in new city districts that are not yet developed. The line is expected to be built in stages. The first stage could open in 2035 and would consist approx. 8 km of line with 6-7 stations. The second stage is assumed to be inaugurated in 2045. The project includes construction of tunnels, underground stations and shafts, mechanical and electrical works, elevated sections and stations, ramps, architectural finishes etc. Copenhagen Metro has set the following 4 project goals for the project: • Reduce the use of resources and climate impact: Metroselskabet has an ambition to reduce the carbon footprint from future metro lines with 50% compared to the existing metro. • Improve passenger experience and operational robustness It is important to make the public transport system, including the metro, as attractive to people as possible to increase usage. As part of that operational robustness and reliable service is an essential. Not only does a good public transport network provide better mobility solutions in the city but greater use reduces the ’invested CO2’ per passenger km and therefore also a key aspect of sustainability. • Improve safety and working environment Everyone should be able to work without accidents or injuries, both in construction and operations of the new metro line. • A contribution to the city A new metroline should physically meet and connect with the city in a way that creates urban space quality and leave space for increased urban biodiversity. At the market dialogue Copenhagen Metro would like to discuss the following topics: • The use of digital tools (modelbased procurement) • Sustainability and experiences with carbon reductions and monitoring of carbon reductions during the construction New methods and materials for achieving the project goals. • Design and architectural finishes • Packaging of works • Health and Safety • Contractual issues Copenhagen Metro expects to conduct the dialogue meeting approx. during week 48 and 50, starting from the 25th of November 2025 and expectedly ending on the 13th of December 2025. The dialogue meeting can take place either as in-person meetings, TEAMS meetings or hybrid meetings. Interested contractors can register for participation in the dialogue meeting by emailing : nkm@m.dkvij@m.dk. Please indicate in your email the date you would like to attend a market dialogue and whether you prefer in-person, TEAMS or hybrid meeting.

title-proc.dan: Rodent Health Monitoring Service
title-proc.eng: Rodent Health Monitoring Service

dan: University of Copenhagen, Department of Experimental Medicine (AEM) calls for tender on the department’s Rodent Health Monitoring Program. Currently, AEM holds 67 dirty bedding mice sentinel cages, 3 dirty bedding rat sentinel cages, and 5 dirty bedding contact medias for mice and 4 dirty bedding contact medias for rats. Complete PCR monitoring of guinea pig colonies will be performed occasionally. Monitoring is performed in accordance with the species specific FELASA recommendations, currently Laboratory Animals 2014, Vol. 48(3) 178-192. In addition, samples after embryo transfers and samples for sick and deceased animals will be analysed. Number of samples can vary depending on research activity. AEM is intending to renew its health monitoring strategy and wishes to introduce animal free health monitoring e.g. by dirty bedding contact media, environmental monitoring, or air filter monitoring, in order to contribute to a reduction in animal usage. This will be an important contribution to the university’s general focus on a reduction of animal usage in research and education.

title-proc.dan: Offentligt udbud af system til opmåling af træ i skov

dan: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen danner grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

hun: Nagy felbontású átjárhatatlan rétegek gyártása és aktualizálása a nem növényzettel borított, új nagy felbontású rétegek talajlefedettségi jellemzőinek keretein belül. A termékeknek folytonosságot kell biztosítaniuk a már meglévő termékekhez, azaz az átjárhatatlansági réteghez és az abból származó termékekhez, valamint a beépített területhez kapcsolódó réteghez, valamint olyan új termékek létrehozásához, amelyek információt nyújtanak a beépített területek változásáról és az állandóan fedetlen talajról és kőzetről.
lav: Augstas izšķirtspējas slāņa (HRL) Necaurlaidības sagatavošana un atjaunināšana jaunā HRL ar augiem neklātas zemes seguma raksturlielumu ietvaros. Produkti nodrošinās nepārtrauktību jau esošajiem produktiem, t. i., Necaurlaidība un no tā atvasinātiem produktiem, un apbūves teritorija, kā arī jaunu produktu izveidi, kas sniedz informāciju par apbūvēto platību izmaiņām un pastāvīgi kailajām augsnēm un iežiem.
swe: Produktion och uppdatering av högupplöst lager (High Resolution Layer - HRL) av ogenomtränglighet inom ramen för de nya HRL-egenskaperna för marktäcke utan vegetation. Produkterna ska ge kontinuitet åt redan befintliga produkter, dvs. ogenomtränglighet och härledda produkter, och tätort, samt bildande av nya produkter som ger information om förändringar i tätort och permanent barmark och sten.
gle: Neamh-thréscaoilteacht shraith ardtaifigh (HRL) faoi chreat na saintréithe HRL nua um chumhdach talún neamhfhásmhair a tháirgeadh agus a nuashonrú. Cuirfidh na táirgí leanúnachas leis na táirgí atá ann cheana, i.e. Neamh-thréscaoilteacht agus a táirgí díorthaithe, agus limistéar tógtha, agus cruthú táirgí nua a thugann faisnéis maidir le hathrú limistéir foirgnithe agus ithreacha loma buana agus carraigeacha loma buana.
ell: Παραγωγή και ενημέρωση επιπέδου υψηλής λύσης (HRL) αδιαπερατότητας στο πλαίσιο των νέων χαρακτηριστικών κάλυψης του εδάφους χωρίς βλάστηση HRL. Τα προϊόντα πρέπει να παρέχουν συνέχεια στα ήδη υπάρχοντα προϊόντα, δηλαδή αδιαπερατότητα και τα παράγωγα προϊόντα της, και δομημένη περιοχή, και δημιουργία νέων προϊόντων που παρέχουν πληροφορίες σχετικά με τις αλλαγές της δομημένης επιφάνειας και τα μόνιμα ακάλυπτα εδάφη και πετρώματα.
spa: Producción y actualización de la impermeabilidad de la capa de alta resolución en el marco de las nuevas características de la cubierta terrestre sin vegetación. Los productos darán continuidad a los ya existentes, es decir, la impermeabilidad y sus productos derivados, y a la superficie construida, así como a la creación de nuevos productos que proporcionen información sobre el cambio de superficie construida y los suelos y rocas descubiertas permanentes.
nld: Productie en actualisering van de ondoordringbaarheid van de hoogresolutielaag (HRL) in het kader van de nieuwe kenmerken van de HRL van de niet-geplante bodembedekking. De producten moeten continuïteit bieden aan de reeds bestaande producten, d.w.z. ondoordringbaarheid en afgeleide producten, alsook bebouwde gebieden, en daarnaast moeten nieuwe producten worden gecreëerd die informatie opleveren over de veranderingen in bebouwde gebieden en over permanent onbegroeide gronden en rotsen.
est: Läbistamatuse HRLi tootmine ja ajakohastamine taimestikuta maakatte omaduste uue HRLi raamistikus. Tooted peavad tagama järjepidevuse juba olemasolevate toodete (st läbistamatuse ja sellest tuletatud toodete) ning hoonestatud ala toodetega ning uute toodete loomise, mis annavad teavet hoonestatud ala muutuste ning püsikatteta muld- ja kivipinnase kohta.
fin: Läpäisemättömyyttä koskevan suuren tarkkuuden kerrosten (High-Resolution Layer — HRL) tuotanto ja päivitys kasvittoman maanpeitteen ominaisuuksia koskevan uuden suuren tarkkuuden kerroksen yhteydessä. Tuotteilla on jatkettava jo olemassa olevia tuotteita, jotka koskevat läpäisemättömyyttä ja siitä johdettuja tuotteita, sekä rakennettua aluetta sekä sellaisten uusien tuotteiden luomista, jotka antavat tietoa rakennetun alueen muutoksesta ja pysyvästä paljaasta maasta ja kalliosta.
pol: Produkcja i aktualizacja warstwy pokrycia terenu o wysokiej rozdzielczości (HRL) w zakresie nowej warstwy o wysokiej rozdzielczości dotyczącej terenu nieporośniętego roślinnością Produkty powinny zapewniać ciągłość już istniejących produktów, tj. obszarów nieprzepuszczalnych i ich produktów pochodnych oraz obszaru budowy, a także tworzenie nowych produktów, które dostarczają informacji o zabudowie terenu oraz glebach i skałach.
hrv: Izrada i ažuriranje sloja visoke rezolucije (high resolution layers — HRL) u okviru novih karakteristika pokrova zemljišta koje nije pokriveno vegetacijom. Proizvodi moraju obezbjediti kontinuitet na već postojećim proizvodima, odnosno nepropusnosti i na njoj izvedenim proizvodima, te stvaranje novih proizvoda koji daju informacije o promjenama na izgrađenom području te trajnom tlu bez vegetacije i kamenu.
ron: Realizarea și actualizarea impermeabilității stratului de înaltă rezoluție (HRL) în cadrul noilor caracteristici de acoperire a terenurilor nevegetate la nivelul de înaltă rezoluție. Produsele trebuie să asigure continuitatea produselor deja existente, și anume a impermeabilității și a produselor derivate, precum și a suprafeței construite și crearea de noi produse care oferă informații privind schimbarea suprafeței construite și solurile și rocile goale permanente.
dan: Produktion og opdatering af uigennemtrængeligheden i højopløsningslaget (HRL) inden for rammerne af de nye HRL-karakteristika for ikke-vegetativt arealdække. Produkterne skal give kontinuitet i forhold til de allerede eksisterende produkter, dvs. uigennemtrængelighed og deraf afledte produkter og bebyggede områder, samt skabe nye produkter, der giver oplysninger om ændringer i bebyggede områder og permanent bare jordarealer og klipper.
ces: Tvorba a aktualizace nepropustnosti vrstvy s vysokým rozlišením (HRL) v rámci nových vlastností půdy nepokryté vegetací HRL. Produkty musí zajišťovat kontinuitu již existujících produktů, tj. nepropustnosti a produktů z nich získaných, zastavené plochy a musí vytvářet nové produkty, které poskytují informace o změně zastavěné plochy a trvalých půdách a horninách.
por: Produção e atualização da impermeabilidade da camada de alta resolução no quadro das novas características de ocupação do solo não-vegetativa. Os produtos devem dar continuidade aos produtos já existentes, ou seja, à impermeabilidade e aos seus produtos derivados, e à área construída, e à criação de novos produtos que forneçam informações sobre as mudanças na área construída e sobre solos e rochas permanentemente nus.
slk: Tvorba a aktualizácia nepriepustných plôch vrstvy s vysokým rozlíšením (HRL) v rámci novej charakteristiky nevegetačnej krajinnej pokrývky. Produkty zabezpečia kontinuitu už existujúcich produktov, t. j. nepriepustných plôch a odvodených produktov, a zastavanej oblasti a vytvorenie nových produktov, ktoré poskytnú informácie o zmene zastavanej plochy a trvalej pôde ponechanej bez porastu a horninách.
fra: Production et mise à jour de l'imperméabilité des couches haute résolution (HRL) dans le cadre des nouvelles caractéristiques de l'occupation non-végétale des sols par des couches haute résolution. Les produits doivent assurer la continuité des produits déjà existants, c’est-à-dire l’imperméabilité et ses produits dérivés, et la surface bâtie, ainsi que la création de nouveaux produits donnant des informations sur les changements de la surface bâtie et les sols et les rochers nus permanents.
mlt: Produzzjoni u aġġornament tal-impermeabbiltà tas-saff b’riżoluzzjoni għolja (HRL) fil-qafas tal-karatteristiċi l-ġodda għall-kopertura ta’ art mhux veġetata tal-HRL. Il-prodotti għandhom jagħtu kontinwità lill-prodotti diġà eżistenti, jiġifieri l-impermeabbiltà u l-prodotti derivati minnha, u ż-żona mibnija, u l-ħolqien ta’ prodotti ġodda li jagħtu informazzjoni dwar tibdil fiż-żona mibnija u fil-ħamrija u fil-blat għeri permanenti.
deu: Produktion und Aktualisierung zur Undurchlässigkeit der hochauflösenden Schicht (HRL) im Rahmen der neuen Merkmale der nicht bewachsenen HRL der Landbedeckung. Die Produkte sollen den bereits bestehenden Produkten, d. h. der Undurchlässigkeit und ihren abgeleiteten Produkten, sowie dem Aufbau von Flächen und der Schaffung neuer Produkte, die Informationen über den Bau von Flächenwechseln und dauerhaft nackten Böden und Felsen geben, Kontinuität verleihen.
lit: Didelės skiriamosios gebos sluoksnio (HRL) neveiklumo naujų HRL neaugalinių žemės dangos charakteristikų kontekste kūrimas ir atnaujinimas. Produktai turi užtikrinti jau esamų produktų, t. y. nepralaidumo ir iš jų pagamintų produktų, bei statybos teritorijos tęstinumą ir naujų produktų, suteikiančių informacijos apie užstatytos teritorijos pasikeitimą ir nuolatinį dirva bei uoliena, kūrimą.
ita: Produzione e aggiornamento dell'impermeabilità dello strato ad alta risoluzione nel quadro delle caratteristiche della copertura del suolo senza vegetazione del nuovo strato ad alta risoluzione I prodotti devono dare continuità ai prodotti già esistenti, vale a dire l'impermeabilità e i prodotti derivati, e all'area edificata, nonché alla creazione di nuovi prodotti che forniscano informazioni sui cambiamenti dell'area edificata e sui suoli nudi e rocciosi permanenti.
bul: Производство и актуализиране на слоя с висока разделителна способност (HRL) за непромокаемостта в рамките на характеристиките на новия слой с висока разделителна способност на земната покривка без растителност. Продуктите трябва да осигурят приемственост на вече съществуващите продукти, т.е. непромокаемост и нейните производни продукти и застроените зони, както и създаването на нови продукти, които дават информация за промяна на застроените зони и постоянните оголени почви и скали.
slv: Izdelava in posodobitev sloja visoke ločljivosti (HRL) o neprepustnosti v okviru novega sloja podatkov visoke ločljivosti o nevegetacijski pokrovnosti tal. Izdelki morajo zagotavljati kontinuiteto že obstoječih izdelkov, tj. izdelkov za nepropustnost in povezanih izdelkov ter izdelkov v zvezi s pozidanimi območji, in prispevati k ustvarjanju novih izdelkov, ki dajejo informacije o spremembah na pozidanih območjih ter v zvezi s trajno golimi tlemi in skalnatimi območji.
eng: Production and update of high-resolution layer (HRL) Imperviousness in the frame of the new HRL non-vegetated land cover characteristics. Products shall give continuity to the already existing products, i.e. Imperviousness and its derived products, and built up area, and the creation of new products that give information on built up area change and permanent bare soils and rock.
