description-proc.swe: Föremålet är upprättandet av ett ramavtal för tjänster med en ekonomisk aktör som omfattar produktion och uppdatering av högupplöst lager (High Resolution Layer - HRL) av ogenomtränglighet inom ramen för de nya HRL-egenskaperna för marktäcke utan vegetation. Produkterna ska ge kontinuitet åt redan befintliga produkter, dvs. ogenomtränglighet och härledda produkter, och tätort, samt bildande av nya produkter som ger information om förändringar i tätort och permanent barmark och sten. Utöver uppgifterna avseende produktion ingår ytterligare 2 konsultuppgifter i anbudsinfordran. För det första, en uppgift om harmonisering med det globala lagret för mänsklig bosättning som för närvarande håller på att tas fram av Europeiska kommissionens gemensamma forskningscenter (JRC) i syfte att vid behov säkerställa överensstämmelse mellan globala och alleuropeiska produkter, för det andra, en uppgift som rör aktiviteter för att främja spridningen av produkter bland användare, såsom stöd till ad hoc-möten, stöd till spridning av produkter och anordnande av utbildningar.
description-proc.lav: Mērķis ir noslēgt pakalpojumu pamatnolīgumu ar uzņēmēju, kas aptver augstas izšķirtspējas slāņa (HRL) necaurlaidības veidošanu un atjaunināšanu jaunā HRL ar augiem neklātas zemes seguma raksturlielumu ietvaros. Produkti nodrošina nepārtrauktību jau esošajiem produktiem, t. i., necaurlaidībai un no tā atvasinātiem produktiem, kā arī jaunu produktu izveidi, kas sniedz informāciju par apbūvēto platību izmaiņām un pastāvīgi kailajām augsnēm un iežiem. Papildus ražošanas uzdevumiem uzaicinājumā uz konkursu ir ietverti divi konsultāciju uzdevumi. Pirmkārt, saskaņošanas uzdevums ar Eiropas Komisijas Kopīgā pētniecības centra (JRC) pašlaik izstrādāto globālo cilvēku apdzīvoto vietu slāni, lai vajadzības gadījumā nodrošinātu saskaņotību starp pasaules un visas Eiropas produktiem. Otrkārt, uzdevums saistībā ar lietotāju iesaistes pasākumiem, piemēram, palīdzība ad hoc sanāksmēm, atbalsts produktu izplatīšanai un apmācību organizēšanai.
description-proc.hun: A tárgy szolgáltatási keretszerződés megkötése egy gazdasági szereplővel, melynek feladata nagy felbontású átjárhatatlan rétegek gyártása és aktualizálása a nem növényzettel borított, új nagy felbontású rétegek talajlefedettségi jellemzőinek keretein belül. A termékeknek folytonosságot kell biztosítaniuk a már meglévő termékekhez, azaz az átjárhatatlansági réteghez és az abból származó termékekhez, valamint a beépített területhez kapcsolódó réteghez, valamint olyan új termékek létrehozásához, amelyek információt nyújtanak a beépített területek változásáról és az állandóan fedetlen talajról és kőzetről. A gyártási feladatokon kívül a pályázati felhívás két tanácsadói feladatot is tartalmaz. Először is, a globális emberi települési réteggel való harmonizáció feladatát jelenleg az Európai Bizottság Közös Kutatóközpontja (JRC) látja el azzal a céllal, hogy szükség esetén biztosítsa a globális és a páneurópai termékek közötti koherenciát. Másodszor, a felhasználói tevékenységekhez kapcsolódó feladat, mint például eseti találkozókhoz biztosított segítségnyújtás, a termékek terjesztésének támogatása és képzések szervezése.
description-proc.gle: Is é an t-ábhar creatchonradh seirbhíse a chur ar bun le hoibreoir eacnamaíoch lena gclúdófar neamh-thréscaoilteacht shraith ardtaifigh (HRL) faoi chreat na saintréithe sraithe ardtaifigh nua um chumhdach talún neamhfhásmhair a tháirgeadh agus a nuashonrú. Beidh leanúnachas ann idir na táirgí seo agus táirgí a bhí ann cheana, i.e. Neamh-thréscaoilteacht agus a táirgí díorthacha, chomh maith le Limistéar faoi Fhoirgnimh, agus maidir le cruthú táirgí nua lena dtugtar faisnéis maidir le hathrú ar an limistéar faoi fhoirgnimh agus ithreacha agus carraigí atá lom ar bhonn buan. Seachas na cúraimí táirgthe áirítear dhá chúram sainchomhairleoireachta leis an nglao ar thairiscintí. Ar an gcéad dul síos, tasc maidir le comhchuibhiú leis an tsraith dhomhanda lonnaíochta daonna atá á táirgeadh faoi láthair ag Airmheán Comhpháirteach Taighde an Choimisiúin Eorpaigh (JRC) d’fhonn comhtháthú a áirithiú idir na táirgí domhanda agus uile-Eorpacha más gá. Ar an dara dul síos, cúram i ndáil le gníomhaíochtaí glactha ag úsáideoirí, amhail cúnamh le cruinnithe ad hoc, tacú le scaipeadh táirgí, agus eagrú oiliúintí.
description-proc.ell: Το αντικείμενο είναι η σύναψη μιας σύμβασης-πλαισίου υπηρεσιών με έναν οικονομικό φορέα που θα καλύπτει την παραγωγή και την ενημέρωση της αδιαπερατότητας του επιπέδου υψηλής λύσης (HRL — High-Resolution Layer) στο πλαίσιο των νέων χαρακτηριστικών κάλυψης του εδάφους χωρίς βλάστηση HRL. Τα προϊόντα πρέπει να παρέχουν συνέχεια στα ήδη υπάρχοντα προϊόντα, δηλαδή αδιαπερατότητα και τα παράγωγα προϊόντα της, και δομημένη επιφάνεια, και δημιουργία νέων προϊόντων που παρέχουν πληροφορίες σχετικά με τις αλλαγές της δομημένης επιφάνειας και τα μόνιμα ακάλυπτα εδάφη και πετρώματα. Εκτός από τα καθήκοντα παραγωγής, στην πρόσκληση υποβολής προσφορών περιλαμβάνονται δύο καθήκοντα παροχής συμβουλών. Πρώτον, ένα καθήκον εναρμόνισης με το παγκόσμιο επίπεδο ανθρώπινων οικισμών που εκπονείται επί του παρόντος από το Κοινό Κέντρο Ερευνών της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής (JRC) με σκοπό τη διασφάλιση της συνοχής μεταξύ των παγκόσμιων και πανευρωπαϊκών προϊόντων, εάν χρειαστεί. Δεύτερον, ένα καθήκον που σχετίζεται με δραστηριότητες αποδοχής από τους χρήστες, όπως παροχή βοήθειας σε ad-hoc συναντήσεις, υποστήριξη στη διάδοση προϊόντων και οργάνωση προγραμμάτων κατάρτισης.
description-proc.spa: El objeto es el establecimiento de un contrato marco de servicios con un operador económico que cubra la producción y actualización de la impermeabilidad de la capa de alta resolución en el marco de las nuevas características de la cubierta terrestre sin vegetación de la capa de alta resolución. Los productos darán continuidad a los ya existentes, es decir, la impermeabilidad y sus productos derivados, y a la superficie construida, así como a la creación de nuevos productos que proporcionen información sobre el cambio de superficie construida y los suelos y rocas descubiertas permanentes. Aparte de las tareas de producción, en la convocatoria de licitación se incluyen dos tareas de consultoría. En primer lugar, una tarea de armonización con la Capa Global de Asentamientos Humanos que actualmente está produciendo el Centro Común de Investigación de la Comisión Europea (JRC) con el fin de garantizar la coherencia entre los productos globales y paneuropeos, en caso necesario. En segundo lugar, una tarea relacionada con las actividades de asimilación de los usuarios, como la asistencia a reuniones ad hoc, el apoyo a la difusión de productos y la organización de formaciones.
description-proc.est: Eesmärk on sõlmida ettevõtjaga teenuste raamleping, mis hõlmab läbistamatuse HRLi tootmist ja ajakohastamist taimestikuta maakatte omaduste uue HRLi raamistikus. Tooted peavad tagama järjepidevuse juba olemasolevate toodete (st läbistamatuse ja sellest tuletatud toodete) ning hoonestatud ala toodetega ning uute toodete loomise, mis annavad teavet hoonestatud ala muutuste ning püsikatteta muld- ja kivipinnase kohta. Pakkumiskutse hõlmab lisaks tootmistegevusele ka kahte nõustamisülesannet. Neist esimene hõlmab ühtlustamist Euroopa Komisjoni Teadusuuringute Ühiskeskuse (JRC) poolt praegu koostamisel oleva ülemaailmse inimasustuse kihiga, et tagada vajaduse korral ülemaailmsete ja üleeuroopaliste toodete vaheline sidusus. Teine ülesanne on seotud kasutajate kaasamise tegevustega, näiteks abi vajaduspõhisel kohtumistel, toodete levitamise toetamine ja koolituste korraldamine.
description-proc.nld: Het voorwerp is het sluiten van een raamovereenkomst voor diensten met een ondernemer voor de productie en actualisering van de ondoordringbaarheid van de hogeresolutielaag (HRL) in het kader van de kenmerken van de nieuwe HRL van niet-geplante bodembedekking. De producten moeten continuïteit bieden aan de reeds bestaande producten, d.w.z. ondoordringbaarheid en afgeleide producten, alsook bebouwde gebieden, en daarnaast moeten nieuwe producten worden gecreëerd die informatie opleveren over de veranderingen in bebouwde gebieden en over permanent onbegroeide gronden en rotsen. Naast de productietaken omvat de oproep tot inschrijving twee adviestaken. Ten eerste een taak inzake harmonisatie met de laag van wereldwijde menselijke vestiging die momenteel wordt geproduceerd door het Gemeenschappelijk Centrum voor onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (JRC) om de samenhang tussen de mondiale en de pan-Europese producten indien nodig te verzekeren. Ten tweede een taak die verband houdt met activiteiten om het inzicht van gebruikers te vergroten, zoals bijstand bij ad-hocvergaderingen, ondersteuning bij de verspreiding van producten en de organisatie van opleidingen.
description-proc.fin: Tämän tarjouspyynnön kohteena on sellaisen palveluja koskevan puitesopimuksen tekeminen talouden toimijan kanssa, joka kattaa läpäisemättömyyttä koskevan suuren tarkkuuden kerrosten (High-Resolution Layer — HRL) tuotannon ja päivityksen kasvittoman maanpeitteen ominaisuuksia koskevan uuden suuren tarkkuuden kerroksen yhteydessä. Tuotteilla on jatkettava jo olemassa olevia tuotteita, jotka koskevat läpäisemättömyyttä ja siitä johdettuja tuotteita, sekä rakennettua aluetta sekä sellaisten uusien tuotteiden luomista, jotka antavat tietoa rakennetun alueen muutoksesta ja pysyvästä paljaasta maasta ja kalliosta. Tuotantotehtävien lisäksi tarjouspyyntöön sisältyy kaksi konsultointitehtävää. Ensimmäinen tehtävä on Euroopan komission yhteisen tutkimuskeskuksen (JRC) parhaillaan tuottaman maailmanlaajuisen asutuksen kerroksen yhdenmukaistaminen, jolla pyritään varmistamaan tarvittaessa maailmanlaajuisten ja yleiseurooppalaisten tuotteiden välinen yhdenmukaisuus. Toinen tehtävä koskee käyttöönottoa käyttäjien keskuudessa koskevia toimia, kuten satunnaisia kokouksia, tuotteiden levittämisen tukemista ja koulutusten järjestämistä.
description-proc.pol: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest zawarcie umowy ramowej o usługi z podmiotem gospodarczym, obejmującej produkcję i aktualizację warstwy pokrycia terenu o wysokiej rozdzielczości (HRL) w zakresie terenu nieporośniętego roślinnością Produkty powinny zapewniać ciągłość już istniejących produktów, tj. obszarów nieprzepuszczalnych i ich produktów pochodnych oraz obszaru budowy, a także tworzenie nowych produktów, które dostarczają informacji o zabudowie terenu oraz glebach i skałach. Oprócz zadań produkcyjnych zaproszenie do składania ofert obejmuje 2 zadania z zakresu doradztwa. Po pierwsze, zadanie dotyczące harmonizacji z globalną warstwą osiedli ludzkich, która jest obecnie przygotowywana przez Wspólne Centrum Badawcze Komisji Europejskiej (JRC) w celu zapewnienia spójności między globalnymi i paneuropejskimi produktami w razie potrzeby. Po drugie, zadanie związane z działaniami polegającymi na korzystaniu przez użytkowników, takie jak pomoc w spotkaniach ad hoc, wsparcie w rozpowszechnianiu produktów i organizacja szkoleń.
description-proc.hrv: Predmet je sklapanje okvirnog ugovora o pružanju usluga s gospodarskim subjektom koji obuhvaća proizvodnju i ažuriranje nepropusnosti sloja visoke rezolucije (High Resolution Layer — HRL) u okviru novih HRL obilježja stanja kopna koje nije pokriveno vegetacijom. Proizvodi moraju obezbjediti kontinuitet na već postojećim proizvodima, odnosno nepropusnosti i na njoj izvedenim proizvodima, te stvaranje novih proizvoda koji daju informacije o promjenama na izgrađenom području te trajnom tlu bez vegetacije i kamenu. Osim zadataka proizvodnje, u poziv na nadmetanje uključena su dva savjetodavna zadatka. Prvo, zadatak usklađivanja s globalnim modelom za ljudska naselja koji trenutačno proizvodi Zajednički istraživački centar Europske komisije (JRC) s ciljem osiguranja usklađenosti globalnih i paneuropskih proizvoda po potrebi. Drugo, zadatak povezan s aktivnostima usvajanja korisnika, kao što je pomoć ad-hoc sastancima, podrška širenju proizvoda i organizacija osposobljavanja.
description-proc.ces: Předmětem je uzavření rámcové smlouvy o poskytování služeb s hospodářským subjektem, která bude zahrnovat výrobu a aktualizaci nepropustnosti vrstvy s vysokým rozlišením (HRL) v rámci nových vlastností půdy nepokryté vegetací HLR. Produkty musí zajišťovat kontinuitu již existujících produktů, tj. nepropustnosti a produktů z nich získaných, zastavené plochy a musí vytvářet nové produkty, které poskytují informace o změně zastavěné plochy a trvalých půdách a horninách. Kromě úkolů v oblasti tvorby jsou ve výzvě k podávání nabídek zahrnuty dva úkoly týkající se poradenství. Za prvé, úkol týkající se harmonizace s globální vrstvou lidských sídel, kterou v současné době vytváří Společné výzkumné středisko Evropské komise (JRC), s cílem zajistit v případě potřeby soudržnost mezi globálními a celoevropskými produkty. Za druhé, úkol týkající se činností uživatelského využití, jako je pomoc při ad-hoc jednáních, podpora šíření produktů a organizace školení.
description-proc.dan: Genstanden er indgåelse af en rammetjenesteydelseskontrakt med en økonomisk aktør, der omfatter produktion og opdatering af uigennemtrængeligheden i højopløsningslaget (HRL — High-Resolution Layer) inden for rammerne af de nye HRL-karakteristika for ikke-vegetativt arealdække. Produkterne skal give kontinuitet i forhold til de allerede eksisterende produkter, dvs. uigennemtrængelighed og deraf afledte produkter og bebyggede områder, samt skabe nye produkter, der giver oplysninger om ændringer i bebyggede områder og permanent bare jordarealer og klipper. Der er ud over produktionsopgaverne inkluderet to rådgivningsopgaver i udbuddet. For det første en opgave med hensyn til harmonisering med laget for globale bosættelses- og bebyggelsesmiljøer, som i øjeblikket udarbejdes af Europa-Kommissionens Fælles Forskningscenter (JRC), med henblik på at sikre sammenhæng mellem de globale og de paneuropæiske produkter, hvis det er nødvendigt. For det andet en opgave vedrørende brugerudnyttelsesaktiviteter, såsom bistand til ad hoc-møder, støtte til formidling af produkter og tilrettelæggelse af undervisning.
description-proc.ron: Obiectul constă în încheierea unui contract-cadru de servicii cu un operator economic care să acopere producerea și actualizarea impermeabilității la nivelul de înaltă rezoluție (HRL) în cadrul noilor caracteristici de acoperire a terenurilor nevegetate de înaltă rezoluție (HRL). Produsele trebuie să asigure continuitatea produselor deja existente, și anume a impermeabilității și a produselor derivate, precum și a suprafeței construite și crearea de noi produse care oferă informații privind schimbarea suprafeței construite și solurile și rocile goale permanente. În afară de sarcinile de producție, în licitație sunt incluse două sarcini de consultanță. În primul rând, o sarcină de armonizare cu nivelul global de așezări umane produs în prezent de Centrul Comun de Cercetare al Comisiei Europene (JRC), în vederea asigurării coerenței între produsele globale și cele paneuropene, dacă este necesar. În al doilea rând, o sarcină legată de activitățile de adoptare a utilizatorilor, cum ar fi asistență pentru reuniunile ad-hoc, susținere pentru diseminarea produselor și organizarea de cursuri de formare.
description-proc.por: O objeto consiste no estabelecimento de um contrato-quadro de serviços com um operador económico que abranja a produção e atualização da impermeabilidade da camada de alta resolução no quadro das novas características de ocupação não-vegetativa do solo da camada de alta resolução. Os produtos devem dar continuidade aos produtos já existentes, ou seja, à impermeabilidade e aos seus produtos derivados, e à área construída, e à criação de novos produtos que forneçam informações sobre as mudanças na área construída e sobre solos e rochas permanentemente nus. Para além das tarefas de produção, estão incluídas no concurso duas tarefas de consultoria. Em primeiro lugar, uma tarefa de harmonização com a camada global de povoamento humano atualmente produzida pelo Centro Comum de Investigação (JRC) da Comissão Europeia, com vista a assegurar a coerência entre os produtos globais e pan-europeus, se necessário. Em segundo lugar, uma tarefa relacionada com atividades de adoção por parte dos utilizadores, tais como assistência a reuniões ad hoc, apoio à divulgação de produtos e organização de formações.
description-proc.slk: Predmetom je uzatvorenie rámcovej zmluvy na poskytovanie služieb s hospodárskym subjektom zastrešujúcim tvorbu a aktualizáciu nepriepustných plôch vrstvy s vysokým rozlíšením v rámci novej charakteristiky nevegetačnej krajinnej pokrývky. Produkty zabezpečia kontinuitu už existujúcich produktov, t. j. nepriepustných plôch a odvodených produktov, a zastavanej oblasti a vytvorenie nových produktov, ktoré poskytnú informácie o zmene zastavanej plochy a trvalej pôde ponechanej bez porastu a horninách. Okrem úloh súvisiacich s výrobou sú súčasťou výzvy na predloženie ponúk dve konzultačné úlohy. Po prvé, úloha harmonizácie s globálnou mapovou vrstvou ľudského osídlenia, ktorú v súčasnosti vypracúva Spoločné výskumné centrum Európskej komisie (JRC), s cieľom zabezpečiť v prípade potreby súdržnosť medzi globálnymi a celoeurópskymi produktmi. Po druhé, úloha týkajúca sa činností využitia zo strany používateľov, ako je pomoc pri príležitostných stretnutiach, podpora šírenia produktov a organizácia školení.
description-proc.mlt: Is-suġġett huwa t-twaqqif ta’ qafas ta’ kuntratt ta’ servizz ma’ operatur ekonomiku li jkopri l-produzzjoni u l-aġġornament tal-impermeabbiltà tas-saff b’riżoluzzjoni għolja (HRL) fil-qafas tal-karatteristiċi l-ġodda għall-kopertura ta’ art mhux veġetata tal-HRL. Il-prodotti għandhom jagħtu kontinwità lill-prodotti diġà eżistenti, jiġifieri l-Impermeabbiltà u l-prodotti derivati minnha, u ż-Żona mibnija, u l-ħolqien ta’ prodotti ġodda li jagħtu informazzjoni dwar tibdil fiż-żona mibnija u fil-ħamrija u fil-blat għeri permanenti. Minbarra l-kompiti tal-produzzjoni, żewġ kompiti ta’ konsulenza huma inklużi fis-sejħa għall-offerti. L-ewwel, kompitu dwar l-armonizzazzjoni mas-saff ta’ postijiet fejn jgħixu n-nies globali li bħalissa qed jiġi prodott mal-Kunsill Ewropew tar-Riċerka tal-Kummissjoni Ewropea (JRC) bil-għan li tiġi żgurata l-koerenza bejn il-prodotti globali u dawk pan-Ewropej jekk meħtieġ. It-tieni, kompitu relatat mal-attivitajiet ta’ adozzjoni mill-utent, bħall-assistenza għal laqgħat ad hoc, bħall-appoġġ għat-tixrid ta’ prodotti u bħall-organizzazzjoni ta’ taħriġ.
description-proc.fra: Le présent marché porte sur l’établissement d’un marché de services cadre avec un opérateur économique couvrant la production et la mise à jour de l’imperméabilité des couches haute résolution (HRL) dans le cadre des nouvelles caractéristiques de l’occupation non-végétale des sols par des couches haute résolution. Les produits doivent assurer la continuité des produits déjà existants, c’est-à-dire l’imperméabilité et ses produits dérivés, et la surface bâtie, ainsi que la création de nouveaux produits donnant des informations sur les changements de la surface bâtie et les sols et les rochers nus permanents. Outre les tâches de production, deux tâches de conseil sont incluses dans l’appel d’offres. Premièrement, une tâche d’harmonisation avec la couche mondiale des établissements humains actuellement réalisée par le Centre commun de recherche de la Commission européenne (JRC) en vue d’assurer la cohérence entre les produits mondiaux et paneuropéens si nécessaire. Deuxièmement, une tâche liée aux activités d’adoption par les utilisateurs, telle que l’assistance à des réunions ad hoc, le soutien à la diffusion des produits et l’organisation de formations.
description-proc.deu: Gegenstand ist der Abschluss eines Dienstleistungsrahmenvertrags mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer, der die Herstellung und Aktualisierung der Imperviousness von High-Resolution Layer (HRL) im Rahmen der neuen HRL-Eigenschaften der nicht bewachsenen Landabdeckung abdeckt. Die Produkte sollen den bereits bestehenden Produkten, d. h. der Imperviousness und ihren abgeleiteten Produkten, sowie dem Aufbau von Flächen und der Schaffung neuer Produkte, die Informationen über den Bau von Flächenwechseln und dauerhaften nackten Böden und Felsen geben, Kontinuität verleihen. Neben den Produktionsaufgaben sind zwei Beratungsaufgaben in der Ausschreibung enthalten. Erstens eine Aufgabe zur Harmonisierung mit der globalen Siedlungsschicht, der derzeit von der Gemeinsamen Forschungsstelle der Europäischen Kommission (JRC) erstellt wird, um bei Bedarf die Kohärenz zwischen den globalen und den gesamteuropäischen Produkten zu gewährleisten. Zweitens, eine Aufgabe im Zusammenhang mit Nutzerakzeptanzaktivitäten, wie Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Treffen, Unterstützung bei der Verbreitung von Produkten und Organisation von Schulungen.
description-proc.lit: Tikslas – sudaryti preliminariąją paslaugų pirkimo sutartį su ekonominės veiklos vykdytoju dėl didelės skiriamosios gebos sluoksnių (HRL) neveiklumo kūrimo ir atnaujinimo naujų HRL neaugintų žemės dangos charakteristikų kontekste. Produktai turi užtikrinti jau esamų produktų, t. y. nepralaidumo ir iš jų pagamintų produktų, bei statybos teritorijos tęstinumą ir naujų produktų, suteikiančių informacijos apie užstatytos teritorijos pasikeitimą ir nuolatinį dirva bei uoliena, kūrimą. Be gamybos užduočių, į kvietimą pateikti pasiūlymus įtrauktos dvi konsultacinės užduotys. Pirma, šiuo metu Europos Komisijos Jungtinio tyrimų centro (JRC) rengiama užduotis suderinti veiksmus su Pasauliniu žmogaus socialinės padėties centru, siekiant užtikrinti, jei reikia, pasaulio ir visos Europos produktų darną. Antra, užduotis, susijusi su naudotojų įsisavinimo veikla, pvz., pagalba ad hoc susitikimams, parama produktų sklaidai ir mokymų organizavimas.
description-proc.ita: L'oggetto è la stipula di un contratto quadro di servizi con un operatore economico riguardante la produzione e l'aggiornamento dell'impermeabilità dello strato ad alta risoluzione nel quadro delle caratteristiche della copertura del suolo senza vegetazione del nuovo strato ad alta risoluzione. I prodotti devono dare continuità ai prodotti già esistenti, vale a dire l'impermeabilità e i prodotti derivati, e all'area edificata, nonché alla creazione di nuovi prodotti che forniscano informazioni sui cambiamenti dell'area edificata e sui suoli nudi e rocciosi permanenti. Oltre agli incarichi di produzione, il bando di gara include due incarichi di consulenza. In primo luogo, un incarico di armonizzazione con lo strato di insediamento umano globale attualmente in fase di produzione da parte del Centro comune di ricerca della Commissione europea (JRC), al fine di garantire la coerenza tra i prodotti globali e paneuropei, se necessario. In secondo luogo, un incarico relativo alle attività di accettazione degli utenti, come l'assistenza a riunioni ad hoc, il sostegno alla diffusione di prodotti e l'organizzazione di corsi di formazione.
description-proc.bul: Предметът е сключването на рамков договор за услуги с икономически оператор, обхващащ производството и актуализирането на слоя с висока разделителна способност (HRL) за непромокаемостта в рамките на характеристиките на новия слой с висока разделителна способност на земната покривка без растителност. Продуктите трябва да осигурят приемственост на вече съществуващите продукти, т.е. непромокаемост и нейните производни продукти и застроените зони, както и създаването на нови продукти, които дават информация за промяна на застроените зони и постоянните оголени почви и скали. Освен производствените задачи, в поканата за участие в търг са включени и две консултантски задачи. Първо, задача по хармонизиране с Глобалния слой на населените места, който се изготвя понастоящем от Съвместния изследователски център на Европейската комисия (JRC) с оглед осигуряване на съгласуваност между глобалните и паневропейските продукти, ако е необходимо. Второ, задача, свързана с дейности по поддръжка за потребителите, като например помощ за ad hoc срещи, подкрепа за разпространение на продукти и организиране на обучения.
description-proc.slv: Predmet je sklenitev okvirne pogodbe o storitvah z gospodarskim subjektom za izdelavo in posodobitev sloja visoke ločljivosti (High-Resolution Layer – HRL) o neprepustnosti v okviru novega sloja podatkov visoke ločljivosti o nevegetacijski pokrovnosti tal. Izdelki morajo zagotavljati kontinuiteto že obstoječih izdelkov, tj. izdelkov za nepropustnost in povezanih izdelkov ter izdelkov v zvezi s pozidanimi območji, in prispevati k ustvarjanju novih izdelkov, ki dajejo informacije o spremembah na pozidanih območjih ter v zvezi s trajno golimi tlemi in skalnatimi območji. Poleg proizvodnih nalog sta v javni razpis vključeni še dve svetovalni nalogi. Prvič, naloga usklajevanja s slojem globalne poseljenosti, ki ga trenutno pripravlja Skupno raziskovalno središče Evropske komisije (JRC), z namenom zagotavljanja skladnosti med globalnimi in vseevropskimi izdelki, če je to potrebno. Drugič, naloga, povezana z dejavnostmi za spodbujanje uporabe s strani uporabnikov, kot so pomoč pri ad hoc sestankih, podpora pri razširjanju izdelkov in organizacija usposabljanj.
description-proc.eng: The subject is the establishment of a framework service contract with an economic operator covering the production and update of high-resolution layer (HRL) imperviousness in the frame of the new HRL non-vegetated land cover characteristics. Products shall give continuity to the already existing products, i.e. Imperviousness and its derived products, and Built up area, and the creation of new products that give information on built up area change and permanent bare soils and rock. Apart from the production tasks two consultancy tasks are included in the call for tenders. First, a task on harmonization with the global human settlement layer currently being produced by the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission (JRC) with the view of ensuring the coherence between the global and the pan European products if needed. Second, a task related to user uptake activities, such as assistance to ad-hoc meetings, support to dissemination of products and organisation of trainings.

description-proc.dan: Dette udbud omfatter spuling og TV-inspektion af kloakker i Frederikshavn Kommune. Der udbydes én rammeaftale med én entreprenør. Rammeaftalen omfatter opgaver inden for spuling, TV-inspektion, brøndinspektion og opmåling, som udføres i forbindelse med inspektioner af kloakker i Frederikshavn Kommune. Følgende opgavetyper er omfattet af rammeaftalen: • Driftsspuling • Spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger og stikledninger • Brøndrapportering • Brøndopmåling-/sondemåling Omfattet i ovennævnte opgaver er alle de for arbejdets fuldstændige færdiggørelse nødvendige arbejder og leverancer, med mindre de specielt er angivet at være uden for opgaven. Driftsspuling Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med de løbende driftsopgaver bestille spuling på det eksisterende afløbssystem. Driftsspuling udføres med genbrugsspuler uden tilhørende TV-inspektion. Spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger og stikledninger Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med de løbende opgaver på det eksisterende afløbssystem bestille spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger for undersøgelse af ledningskvalitet og systemsammenhæng. Herunder søgning, afmærkning og opmåling af skjulte brønde. Derudover vil Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S udføre TV-inspektion af stikledninger for undersøgelser af kvalitet, funktion og stedbestemmelse (kortlægning). Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med udførelse af nye kloakanlæg, byggemodninger mv. udføre TV-inspektion af de nye kloakanlæg som dokumentation for kloakledningernes kvalitet. Opgaverne vil i videst muligt omfang blive samlet i bestilling, således at de kan udføres inden for normal arbejdstid. Mindre opgaver udføres normalt inden for 1 arbejdsdag medmindre andet er aftalt i bestilling. Større opgaver udføres inden for en aftalt startdato og forfaldsdato. Der kan desuden være opgaver, der forudsætter tilkaldelse uden bestillingsseddel, som skal forventes udført og afrapporteret fra dag til dag. Entreprenøren skal ved akutte henvendelser kunne stille med materiel og mandskab inden for 1 dag uanset ugedag. Bestillinger kan både omfatte enkeltledninger eller flere sammenhængende enkeltledninger i et kloakopland. Som hovedregel udføres spuling og TV-inspektion af hele ledningstrækninger. Brøndrapportering Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i nogle tilfælde have udført inspektion af brønde for registrering af tilslutninger og tilstand. Brøndopmåling-/sondemåling Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i nogle tilfælde have udført opmåling af brønde og punkter (koordinater og kote) med GPS eller opmålt med sonde til brug for ledningsregistrering. Kontraktperioden løber fra og med den 1. maj 2025 og til og med den 30. april 2027. Herudover har udbyder option på forlængelse af rammeaftalen på samme vilkår i 2x1 år. Den maksimale værdi af det samlede træk på rammeaftalen i rammeaftaleperioden er, uanset hvad der i øvrigt måtte fremgå af rammeaftalen, 10.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms, mens det forventede forbrug på rammeaftalen estimeres til 3.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms.

title-proc.eng: Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM

eng: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is executing a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation

description-proc.eng: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is executing a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.

description-proc.eng: DALO is considering publishing a future tender for the supply and sustainment of an advanced sigthing system (also called "FCS" - Fire Control System), able to cover several weapon platforms, including 84mm recoilles rifle (hereunder CG M4), 12.7mm heavy machine guns (HMG) and 40mm automatic grenade launchers (hereunder H&K GMG). Full compatibility with the SAAB Dynamics AB Carl-Gustaf M4 system (including FIREBOLT technology) is in this case a must-have. The offered FCS must also be able to provide automated ballistic calculation functionality allowing for engaging static and moving targets with different weapons and in differnt situations (from a static position, from a vehicle/vessel/aircraft) and at the weapons' effective ranges. Due to the system's specific interaction with other systems, it is expected that the Supplier will not only be able to meet the technical requirements (mostly rooted in the desired performance across diferent use patterns), but that they will also be able to guarantee integration with systems such as indoor simulators already in use by the Danish Defence (GSIMS from Thales). Sustainment of DALO's existing legacy fleet of in-service FCS (Aimpoint FCS14 RE) may also be the part of the tender. DALO is therefore seeking information in order to prepare for the possible tender. DALO encourages all potential suppliers to show their interest by answering this Request for Information (RFI).

title-proc.eng: Submarine Cable project consultancies DPS

eng: This DPS concerns consultancies relating to Polar Connect step 1. Polar Connect is a submarine fiber cable project with a shortest route between and East Asia starting from Norway going north of Greenland to North America and onwards to Asia. The cable is intended to be a hybrid cable that will support generic telecommunications connectivity, as well as supporting research using smart cable technologies. The Polar Connect step 1 runs for 3 years from January 2025 to December 2027 and is aimed to achieve several objectives in the areas described below. • Engagement with stakeholders interested in securing global connectivity and providing access to an innovative research instrument made of sensors along the subsea cable. • Detailed mapping of the Arctic Ocean, which starts with preparing pre-survey of the route, mission planning considering the critical weather conditions and costs, three survey missions, and the analysis of the survey data. • Technical planning and design activities, including route planning, planning of the resilience, determination of the optimal locations of potential cable landing sites and branching units, including security and access control, environmental impact, permitting and regulatory compliance, collaboration with local authorities, emergency response and repair, remote monitoring and control systems, and back-up communication systems. • Sensor technology planning, analysis of available technologies for cable sensing and their contributions for security-, integrity-, scientific- and environmental monitoring. It is foreseen that there will be consultancies needed for several areas.

title-proc.dan: Offentligt udbud af system til opmåling af træ i skov

dan: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen danner grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.
Naturstyrelsen
Dralle A/S

description-proc.dan: Naturstyrelsen er en styrelse i Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart, der varetager opgaver i statens skove, naturområder og langs kysterne i Danmark. Naturstyrelsen forvalter cirka 200.000 hektar statslige skove og naturområder, så der skabes størst mulig værdi for samfundet i form af gode rammer for friluftslivet, beskyttelse af naturen og effektiv drift af styrelsens skove og andre naturområder. I forbindelse med Naturstyrelsens skovning af løv- og nåletræ opstilles effekter i stak- og stokeffekter ved skov-veje, der er tilgængelige for lastbiltransport. Disse effekter består af rundtræ og flistoppe (stakke) og kævler og langtømmer (stokke), som skal opmåles, således at rumfanget kan beregnes. Naturstyrelsen ønsker tilbud på et samlet system til opmåling af begge typer effekter hovedsageligt fra de danske statsskove. Selve opmålingen foretages af Naturstyrelsens medarbejdere. Systemet skal opsamle data, foretage databehandling og beregne vedmasser på stak- og stokeffekter af skovet træ ud fra indsamlede og registrerede opmålingsdata. Systemet skal derefter sammenkæde data, som gør, at rund-træstakke, flistopstakke og enkeltstokke kan indlæses i Naturstyrelsens eksisterende IT-baserede arealdriftssystem SABA (Systemunderstøttelse af Bæredygtig Arealdrift) og i Webbutikken. Systemet skal desuden håndtere data vedrørende effekterne og oplysninger om lokale forhold, ligesom effekternes placering skal fastsættes med GPS, og der skal tages foto, som bruges til senere identifikation og registrering. Det skal endvidere være muligt direkte på stedet manuelt at indtaste forskellige oplysninger om fx kvalitet i systemet, således at oplysningerne registreres og lagres sammen med den effekt, de hører til. Opmålingen danner grundlag for Naturstyrelsens handelsafregning med savværker og detailkunder mv.

description-proc.eng: Dear potential tenderer Metroselskabet is inviting you to participate in an information meeting with potential interested contractors with interest in the construction of the new M5 metro line in Copenhagen. We are pleased to inform you that The Government and The City of Copenhagen have just reached an political agreement to construct the new M5 Metro Line project in Copenhagen, with nine stations between Copenhagen Central Station and Lynetteholm across Amager. The line is expected to open in two stages in 2036 and 2045 respectively. The goal of M5 is to provide efficient public transport to both existing urban areas that currently do not have metro service (on Amager), as well as new urban development areas, including in the East Harbour (Kløverparken, Refshaleøen and Lynetteholm). The M5 will also add an extra connection across the harbour. The new line will be approx. 15.7 km long standalone metro line with up to 9 stations in total, some underground and some elevated. Some stations and part of the line will be underground in existing dense city environment, and some will be in new city districts that are not yet developed. The first stage is expected to be approx. 6 km. bored twin tunnel with 5 underground stations, approx. 2 km viaducts and 1 elevated station. For the Civil works the project includes construction of tunnels, underground stations and shafts, mechanical and electrical works, elevated sections and stations, ramps, architectural finishes etc. For the transportation system the project includes rolling stock, scada, signalling, passenger information system, power supply, control and maintenance center etc. The first stage is expected to be inaugurated in 2036. Following the adoption of the construction act Metroselskabet expects the procurement process to start in 2026. The second stage is assumed to be inaugurated in 2045 and will be procured in separate contracts. Metroselskabet has set the following 4 project goals for the project: • Reduce the use of resources and climate impact: Metroselskabet has an ambition to reduce the carbon footprint from future metro lines with 50% compared to the existing metro. • Improve passenger experience and operational robustness. It is important to make the public transport system, including the metro, as attractive to people as possible to increase usage. As part of that, operational robustness and reliable service are essential. Not only does a good public transport network provide better mobility solutions in the city but greater use reduces the ’invested CO2’ per passenger km and therefore also a key aspect of sustainability. • Improve safety and the working environment Everyone should be able to work without accidents or injuries, both in construction and operations of the new metro line. • A contribution to the city. A new Metro line should physically meet and connect with the city in a way that creates urban space quality and leave space for increased urban biodiversity. At the market dialogue Metroselskabet would like to discuss the following topics. In light of this development, we would like to invite you to a 30-minute information meeting to discuss the forthcoming process. This session will be conducted via Microsoft Teams and is scheduled for 29th of April at 2:30PM-3:00PM . Please note that this will be a group meeting; individual sessions will be arranged at a later stage as the project progresses. To confirm your participation and receive the Teams meeting link, kindly inform [VIJ@m.dk & NKM@m.dk]. We look forward to your attendance and to share more details about the M5 Metro Line project. Kind Regards, Metroselskabet I/S

description-proc.dan: Dette udbud omfatter spuling og TV-inspektion af kloakker i Frederikshavn Kommune. Der udbydes én rammeaftale med én entreprenør. Rammeaftalen omfatter opgaver inden for spuling, TV-inspektion, brøndinspektion og opmåling, som udføres i forbindelse med inspektioner af kloakker i Frederikshavn Kommune. Følgende opgavetyper er omfattet af rammeaftalen: • Driftsspuling • Spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger og stikledninger • Brøndrapportering • Brøndopmåling-/sondemåling Omfattet i ovennævnte opgaver er alle de for arbejdets fuldstændige færdiggørelse nødvendige arbejder og leverancer, med mindre de specielt er angivet at være uden for opgaven. Driftsspuling Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med de løbende driftsopgaver bestille spuling på det eksisterende afløbssystem. Driftsspuling udføres med genbrugsspuler uden tilhørende TV-inspektion. Spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger og stikledninger Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med de løbende opgaver på det eksisterende afløbssystem bestille spuling og TV-inspektion af hovedledninger for undersøgelse af ledningskvalitet og systemsammenhæng. Herunder søgning, afmærkning og opmåling af skjulte brønde. Derudover vil Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S udføre TV-inspektion af stikledninger for undersøgelser af kvalitet, funktion og stedbestemmelse (kortlægning). Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i forbindelse med udførelse af nye kloakanlæg, byggemodninger mv. udføre TV-inspektion af de nye kloakanlæg som dokumentation for kloakledningernes kvalitet. Opgaverne vil i videst muligt omfang blive samlet i bestilling, således at de kan udføres inden for normal arbejdstid. Mindre opgaver udføres normalt inden for 1 arbejdsdag medmindre andet er aftalt i bestilling. Større opgaver udføres inden for en aftalt startdato og forfaldsdato. Der kan desuden være opgaver, der forudsætter tilkaldelse uden bestillingsseddel, som skal forventes udført og afrapporteret fra dag til dag. Entreprenøren skal ved akutte henvendelser kunne stille med materiel og mandskab inden for 1 dag uanset ugedag. Bestillinger kan både omfatte enkeltledninger eller flere sammenhængende enkeltledninger i et kloakopland. Som hovedregel udføres spuling og TV-inspektion af hele ledningstrækninger. Brøndrapportering Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i nogle tilfælde have udført inspektion af brønde for registrering af tilslutninger og tilstand. Brøndopmåling-/sondemåling Frederikshavn Spildevand A/S vil i nogle tilfælde have udført opmåling af brønde og punkter (koordinater og kote) med GPS eller opmålt med sonde til brug for ledningsregistrering. Kontraktperioden løber fra og med den 1. maj 2025 og til og med den 30. april 2027. Herudover har udbyder option på forlængelse af rammeaftalen på samme vilkår i 2x1 år. Den maksimale værdi af det samlede træk på rammeaftalen i rammeaftaleperioden er, uanset hvad der i øvrigt måtte fremgå af rammeaftalen, 10.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms, mens det forventede forbrug på rammeaftalen estimeres til 3.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms.

description-proc.eng: The Contract comprises the operation and maintenance of the complete system of the Copenhagen Metro, metro lines M1, M2, M3 and M4 (the “O&M contract”). The lines span over 44 stations (30 underground stations and 14 above ground stations) and approximately 40 kilometres doubletrack in the Copenhagen area. The metro system operates 24/7 with a varying headway throughout the day. Currently, the metro has approximately 2 million passengers per week on average. This figure is expected to increase in the coming years. The metro is a fully automated and driverless, GoA4 system, it consists of two separated systems; M1/M2 and M3/M4 each with own control and maintenance center and is operated without any operator staff (e.g. stewards) on the trains. The O&M contract comprises a mobilisation period of approximately 9-12 months after the signing of the O&M contract and prior to the start of the operation period. In the operation period the winning tenderer (the “O&M Provider”) will handle all operation and the majority of maintenance of the complete metro system. At the start of the operation period the assets that are owned by the contracting entity, Metroselskabet I/S (“Metroselskabet”), will be made the available to the O&M Provider. The assets include e.g.: • Tunnels and structures, including stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts, bridges and embankments • Railway infrastructure, including power supply, traction power, permanent way, ATC system, platform screen doors, automatic platform gates, passenger security and information systems, SCADA, access control systems and intrusion detection systems, radio communication systems and transmission systems, passenger-counting system, and the equipment related to the Rejsekort (travel card) system and ticketing system • Electrical and mechanical installations and equipment in tunnels, structures, stations, transfer areas / tunnels, shafts and CMC, including ventilation • Passenger vehicles and service vehicles • Escalators • Control and Maintenance Center, including outdoor areas • Documentation, manuals and procedures • IT systems and programmes forming part of the metro system • Certain management systems • Movables • Consumables (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract) • Spare parts (a smaller amount is expected to be available at commencement of the O&M contract). Additionally, as further described in the tender material, spare parts to certain systems will be available via a contract which Metroselskabet has entered into separately. The O&M Provider is expected to be entrusted with the full responsibility for the daily operation and the majority of the maintenance of assets forming part of the metro system, including provision of spare parts and consumables. The O&M Provider’s services, tasks, etc. under the O&M contract are, on an overall level, expected to include, but not be limited to: - Traffic operations, including operation of traffic systems and staffing. - Passenger services, e.g. traffic information and customer service. - Maintenance of assets, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, provision of spare parts, obsolescence management, cleaning, maintenance optimisation, etc. - Information technology services, including cyber security. - Ticketing and passenger counting. - Communication based on communication plans and strategies. - Organisation and management services, e.g. human ressource management, management of additional services, management of third-party works, technology management, data management, quality management, configuration management, railway safety management, operational railway access management, security and resilience management, occupational health and safety management (OHS), environmental management energy and carbon management and risk management. - Reporting, planning, documentation, etc., including e.g. delivery of various reports at certain intervals, provision of other information, and compilation, updating and maintenance of documentation. - Services in the mobilisation phase and in connection with the expiry of the O&M contract (demobilization), including certain transitional services to assist in the mobilisation of a potential new O&M Provider. In addition, the O&M Provider may be requested to perform additional tasks and projects in relation to the metro system, e.g. development / improvement of assets, on an optional basis. Furthermore, the O&M Provider may be requested to participate in and provide services / deliverables in relation to a number of larger investment / reinvestment projects and other third-party projects in relation to the metro system during the O&M contract period that are expected to be subject to separate procurements / contracts. These projects are expected to include replacement of rolling stock and signaling for the M1 and M2. The Danish Transfer of Undertakings Act (Act no. 710 of 20 August 2002 on the rights of employees in connection with transfer of undertaking as amended) applies to this contract. This entails that employees of the current O&M provider and subcontractors will transfer to the O&M Provider on the same terms as the employees were employed by the current O&M provider and subcontractors pursuant to the provisions in the Danish Transfer of Undertakings Act subsequent to the O&M Provider’s commencement of operation and maintenance of the Copenhagen Metro M1-M4. The duration of the O&M contract is expected to be 12 years (excluding the mobilisation period) with options for extension for a total of 3 years. After the expiry of the operation periode, the O&M Provider must, to a limited extent, provide assistance to Metroselskabet and/or to a potential new O&M provider in relation to the operation and maintenance of the Metro.

title-proc.dan: supply of Rodent Health Monitoring Service.

dan: University of Copenhagen, Department of Experimental Medicine (AEM) calls for tender on the department’s Rodent Health Monitoring Program. Currently, AEM holds 67 dirty bedding mice sentinel cages, 3 dirty bedding rat sentinel cages, and 5 dirty bedding contact medias for mice and 4 dirty bedding contact medias for rats. Complete PCR monitoring of guinea pig colonies will be performed occasionally. Monitoring is performed in accordance with the species specific FELASA recommendations, currently Laboratory Animals 2014, Vol. 48(3) 178-192. In addition, samples after embryo transfers and samples for sick and deceased animals will be analysed. Number of samples can vary depending on research activity. AEM is intending to renew its health monitoring strategy and wishes to introduce animal free health monitoring e.g. by dirty bedding contact media, environmental monitoring, or air filter monitoring, in order to contribute to a reduction in animal usage. This will be an important contribution to the university’s general focus on a reduction of animal usage in research and education.
Københavns Universitet
Charles River Laboratories, Research Model and Services, Germany GmbH

title-proc.eng: Framework Agreement regarding High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM

eng: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) has executed a tender of High bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM to be used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence often operates outside of traditionel internet infrastructure. Current acces to the internet in such locations is obtained via SATCOM, based on geostationary satellite constellations at a distance of more than 35.000 kilometres from Earth. This very long distance communication limits both latency and the bandwidth of such systems. With increased need for internet access, pertaining to administrative tasks and crew Wi-Fi, a new SATCOM system with low latency and high bandwidth is required. It is expected that the data based communication will increase in the future, as the service becomes more widely used in the Danish Defence. The Danish Defence operates all over the world both on land and at sea. DALO therefore needs a solution with global coverage. However, DALO is also aware that the different solutions on the market at present can not quarantee global coverage. Therefore, to maximise the connectivity, DALO whishes to acquire two solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM. It is not the plan that both solutions of High Bandwidth Low Latency SATCOM will be installed and used on the different platforms. However, certain platforms might have both solutions installed. The solution is intended to be used on both stationary and moving platforms, and as such it is required to be able to function on-the-move. The solution will be subjected to harsh weather conditions of the Arctic with low temperatures, high winds and rough seas, but also warm sub-tropic climate. As the vessels of the Royal Danish Navy will periodically be docked for maintenance for extended periods of time, DALO whishes a solution where the connection can be frozen/paused. The framework agreement will concist of Terminals and Subscriptions (Airtime) as well as training, repair-services and spare parts.
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation

description-proc.eng: Dear potential tenderer, Following our initial information meeting in the spring, we are pleased to inform you that the M5 Metro Line project has now moved further in our strategic planning. We are therefore ready to invite you to a new information meeting to share the latest updates and outline the forthcoming process. The goal of the M5 is to provide efficient, sustainable public transport to both existing urban areas currently without metro service (particularly on Amager) and new urban development zones, including the East Harbour (Kløverparken, Refshaleøen, and Lynetteholm). The M5 will also offer a new cross-harbour connection. Project overview: Approx. 15.7 km standalone metro line with up to 9 stations (underground and elevated) Stage 1: ~6 km bored twin tunnel with 5 underground stations, ~2 km of viaducts, and 1 elevated station Civil Works scope: tunnels, underground stations and shafts, mechanical and electrical works, elevated sections and stations, ramps, architectural finishes etc. Transportation System scope: rolling stock, SCADA, signalling, passenger information system, power supply, control and maintenance centre etc. Stage 1 opening: 2036 (procurement expected to begin in 2026, following adoption of the construction act) Stage 2 opening: 2045 (procured under separate contracts) Project goals Reduce resources and climate impact – 50% CO₂ reduction target compared to the current metro network. Improve passenger experience and operational robustness – reliable, attractive services that promote public transport use. Enhance safety and working environment – zero-accident ambition for both construction and operations. Contribute to the city – integrate with and improve the urban environment, enhancing biodiversity. Information Meeting Details: Date: Wednesday, 8 October 2025 Time: 10:00-11:00 AM (Danish time) Registration is not necessary; the meeting can be accessed through the link below. However, if you still choose to inform us of your participation by email, please note that no confirmation will be sent, as the only way to attend the meeting is via the Teams link. Teams meeting link: https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/ap/t-59584e83/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fteams.microsoft.com%2Fl%2Fmeetup-join%2F19%253ameeting_ZTUwMjViODQtZTIyNy00ZGEyLTkwYTgtOGEyNWE4NjljMzhh%2540thread.v2%2F0%3Fcontext%3D%257b%2522Tid%2522%253a%252268e252cb-cfc6-43ed-9a1a-c863a2bc0223%2522%252c%2522Oid%2522%253a%252261b80b2b-fbeb-4363-8bc1-a6b9b85a1da4%2522%257d&data=05%7C02%7CNKM%40m.dk%7Cf14f0fbccc1947f1a0a808ddfbfb7156%7C68e252cbcfc643ed9a1ac863a2bc0223%7C0%7C0%7C638943779545629078%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=B9K5L0pQaWR9I1J12UGS6ff%2BG6JGC4AqCbfaGz93JIg%3D&reserved=0 Market Dialogue Registration Following or before the meeting, we invite you to register on our “Byggeprojekt” platform to take part in the upcoming market dialogue processes. description-proc.eng: Every year GEUS carries out fieldwork during spring and summer making use of ad hoc and full charter helicopter services. GEUS mainly uses smaller single-engine helicopters and work often takes place in unmapped areas. On occasion GEUS organizes geological field trips for professionals and VIP visitors. GEUS expects a continued strong commitment in Greenland for the years to come, a commitment that implies the use of helicopter services in all parts of Greenland. The need of helicopter assistance for GEUS operations varies between 150 and 250 hours per year with an average of 219 hours (2016-2019) for both full charter and ad hoc operations. GEUS expects similar fieldwork activities for the years to come. To ensure the supply of helicopter services for such fieldwork activities GEUS wishes to enter Framework Agreements with one or more experienced service providers that can provide GEUS with helicopter services in Greenland for a four-year period. For practical purposes, six geographical zones (A–F), “areas of performance”, have been defined, which together cover all of Greenland, see Enclosure 3 Technical and Operational Specifications Helicopter Services in Greenland 2026 - 2029 for a map of the areas.

title-proc.eng: Ground station: LEGION 400

eng: The LEGION 400 from Safran is the only solution that can provide a triband coaxial feed horn for all s, x and Ka band. This makes it possible to use all bands synchroniously. This is important because we expect to use Ka band in combination with either s or x or both. Alternative solutions require physical change of feed horn to go from one frequency to another, this is not feasable as we would need continous communication on two or more frequency bands at a time.

title-proc.eng: North Sea I, South, Offshore Wind Farm

eng: The Danish Parliament has in recent years agreed to a large expansion in offshore wind farms in Denmark. The aim is to ensure the green transition and strengthening the future security of supply of energy in Denmark. The political agreements that this procurement concerns are: - Climate Agreement from 29 June 2018, - Climate Agreement from 22 June 2020, - the Financial Act from 4 December 2022, - Climate Agreement regarding green electricity and heat from 25 June 2022 - Additional Agreement on the procurement details regarding 6 GW offshore wind and Energy Island Bornholm from May 30 2023, and - Agreement on procurement frameworks for three offshore wind farms from 19 May 2025 as adjusted on 7 November 2025. This procurement concerns the establishment of one (1) new large-scale offshore wind farm named North Sea I, South, pursuant to the directive 2014/24/EU on public procurement as implemented into Danish law by the Danish Public Procurement Act, cf. consolidated act no. 116 of 3 February 2025 with later amendments (in Danish: Udbudsloven). The procurement procedure applicable to this procurement constitutes an open procedure, cf. section 56 of the Danish Public Procurement Act. The Concessionaire is granted a right and obligations to utilise the concession area for the establishment and operation of an offshore wind farm with a minimum capacity of 1 GW for the purpose of producing and distributing electricity at the sole risk and expense of the Concessionaire. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the concessionaire of North Sea I, South Offshore Wind Farm, will be economically supported for the electricity produced from the minimum capacity by a capability based two-way contract for difference (“CfD”) scheme for a period of 20 years. Under the capability-based two-way CfD scheme, the Concessionaire must make payments to the Danish State in months where the strike price (equal to the “bid price” of the Successful Tenderer) is lower than the reference price (to be calculated by the DEA as the weighted monthly average of the day-ahead prices, weighted by the maximum power production capability of the turbines or “Available Active Power” as further set out in the procurements material). There is no cap on the payments from the Concessionaire to the Danish State, and the Concessionaire has no option to opt out of the capability-based two-way CfD scheme. Correspondingly, in months where the strike price is higher than the reference price, the Concessionaire will receive subsidies up to cap of 6.6 billion DKK excl. VAT (2025-prices) in the form of payments from the Danish State. Reference is made to the Annex F (Concession Agreement) and Appendix 3 (Capability-Based Two-Way Contract for Difference) for an overall description of the principles in capability-based two-way CfD scheme. The scheme constitutes State aid within the meaning of Article 107(1) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). Please note that the name of the offshore wind farm can be changed by the Danish Energy Agency (“DEA”). Such change will not affect the geographical location of the offshore wind farm. The North Sea I, South will in the following be called “the Offshore Wind Farm”. The minimum capacity of the Offshore Wind Farm shall be established no later 31 December 2034. The concessionaire will in special cases be entitled to an extension of this deadline. Connection of the Offshore Wind Farm to the Danish transmission grid is voluntary for the concessionaire. The Concession Agreement further enables the Concessionaire to establish overplanting capacity in excess of the required minimum capacity within the concession area, i.e. it is optional for Concessionaire to establish more than 1 GW capacity within the Concession Area. Furthermore, the Concessionaire may exploit the production capacity of electricity from the Offshore Wind Farm for energy production, such as but not limited to innovative energy production (e.g. Power-to-X), if this is otherwise possible within the applicable legislation. With the sole exception of the capability-based two-way CfD scheme, the Concessionaire bears all commercial risks associated with the establishment, operation and decommissioning of the Offshore Wind Farm, including any potential overplanting capacity. Such commercial risks include but is not limited to, legislative changes and general market conditions and demands. Additionally, the Concessionaire is responsible for the commercial risks related to any innovative energy production (e.g. Power-to-X facility). The Concessionaire shall bear the costs as stipulated in the construction permit and/or procurement material. Please note that contrary to earlier procurements rounds concerning offshore wind the Concessionaire shall not bear the actual cost of the temporary and permanent preventive measures, which by decision of the Danish Defence must be implemented by the Concessionaire to prevent deteriorations in the quality of the current military radio communication and radar surveillance caused by the Offshore Wind Farm. Such costs will be borne by the Danish Defence. Furthermore, contrary to earlier procurements rounds for offshore wind, the Concessionaire shall not pay the cost of the offshore preliminary investigations performed by Energinet, cf. section 23 (3) of the Renewable Energy Act (RE Act), statutory order no. 132 of 6 February 2024. Such costs will be borne by the Danish State. The location site of the Offshore Wind Farm is further stated below under section "Place of Performance" as well as in the procurement material Appendix 2 (Location of the Concession Area). Reference is further made to the regulation in the Procurement Specifications, Annex F (Concession Agreement), Appendix 1 (Project Specification), and the procurement material as a whole.

description-proc.eng: The contracting authority has determined that the tender did not result in a sufficiently broad level of competition. Consequently, the tender is being cancelled. Every year GEUS carries out fieldwork during spring and summer making use of ad hoc and full charter helicopter services. GEUS mainly uses smaller single-engine helicopters and work often takes place in unmapped areas. On occasion GEUS organizes geological field trips for professionals and VIP visitors. GEUS expects a continued strong commitment in Greenland for the years to come, a commitment that implies the use of helicopter services in all parts of Greenland. The need of helicopter assistance for GEUS operations varies between 150 and 250 hours per year with an average of 219 hours (2016-2019) for both full charter and ad hoc operations. GEUS expects similar fieldwork activities for the years to come. To ensure the supply of helicopter services for such fieldwork activities GEUS wishes to enter Framework Agreements with one or more experienced service providers that can provide GEUS with helicopter services in Greenland for a four-year period. For practical purposes, six geographical zones (A–F), “areas of performance”, have been defined, which together cover all of Greenland, see Enclosure 3 Technical and Operational Specifications Helicopter Services in Greenland 2026 - 2029 for a map of the areas.

description-proc.eng: Every year GEUS carries out fieldwork during spring and summer making use of ad hoc and full charter helicopter services. GEUS mainly uses smaller single-engine helicopters and work often takes place in unmapped areas. On occasion GEUS organizes geological field trips for professionals and VIP visitors. GEUS expects a continued strong commitment in Greenland for the years to come, a commitment that implies the use of helicopter services in all parts of Greenland. The need of helicopter assistance for GEUS operations varies between 150 and 250 hours per year with an average of 219 hours (2016-2019) for both full charter and ad hoc operations. GEUS expects similar fieldwork activities for the years to come. To ensure the supply of helicopter services for such fieldwork activities GEUS wishes to enter Framework Agreements with one or more experienced service providers that can provide GEUS with helicopter services in Greenland for a four-year period.

title-proc.eng: The acquisition of Fixed Air Defence Radars (FADR), including support for sustainment and training

eng: The Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) has entered into a contract on 11 December 2025 with Lockheed Martin Global, Incorporated, (Lockheed Martin), concerning the acquisition of Fixed Air Defence Radars (FADR), including support for sustainment and training. The contract covers the acquisition of three FADRs to be installed at different sites across the Kingdom of Denmark, and an option for DALO to procure one additional FADR. The contract is divided into two agreements: 1) a contract regarding the delivery and installation of the FADRs (the Acquisition Contract), and 2) a framework agreement (the Sustainment Agreement) regarding support for sustainment (spare parts, repair services and technical support) and training for a period of up to 25 years The overall purpose of the acquisition is to replace and expand the existing radar capacity thereby improving and expanding airspace surveillance over the Kingdom of Denmark. To protect the essential interests of Denmark’s security, the contract has been awarded directly to Lockheed Martin pursuant to Article 346(1)(b) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU), following a limited competitive process.
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation

title-proc.dan: EU-udbud af LIFE IP NATUREMAN naturmonitering af overvågningspunkter (LIFE16 IPE/DK/006, ACTION D1)

dan: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø (herefter SGAV) er partner i projektet LIFE IP Natureman (2018-2027). Projektets overordnede formål er at forbedre naturkvaliteten i de himmerlandske og midtjyske ådale (på tværs af 11 Natura 2000-områder) i forhold til udbredelsen og tilstanden af habitatnaturtyperne kildevæld, rigkær, tidvis våd eng, tørt kalksandsoverdrev, kalkoverdrev og surt overdrev, samt status for en række fokusarter knyttet til disse naturtyper. SGAV har ansvaret for projektets monitering og afrapportering af naturplejeindsatsens effekt på naturtyper og arter. Den udbudte opgave indgår i den afsluttende monitering og består af en stikprøvevis overvågning, der på tværs af LIFE IP Natureman skal dokumentere effekten af forskellige typer indsatser på udvalgte arealer. Der skal i alt moniteres 552 punkter/prøvefelter fordelt i 10 habitatområder. Opgaven skal løses i henhold til ”Vejledning til supplerende monitering af lysåbne naturarealer i LIFE IP Natureman”, jf. udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.1. Opgaven skal overordnet set udføres i perioden fra 1. juni 2026 til og med 31. august 2026. Leverandøren skal overholde overvågningsvinduet for de enkelte punkter. Disse fremgår af GIS-filen, jf. udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.2. Metoden beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.1 tager udgangspunkt i den metode, der bruges til NOVANA lysåben kontrolovervågning (beskrevet i den tekniske anvisning TA-N01 Overvågning af terrestriske naturtyper), suppleret med indsamling af ekstra data som fx registrering af arter i pinpoint og registrering af blomstring. Desuden afsættes punkterne med d-GPS.
Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø

Opgaven skal løses i henhold til ”Vejledning til supplerende monitering af lysåbne naturarealer i LIFE IP Natureman”, jf. udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.1. Opgaven skal overordnet set udføres i perioden fra 1. juni 2026 til og med 31. august 2026. Leverandøren skal overholde overvågningsvinduet for de enkelte punkter. Disse fremgår af GIS-filen, jf. udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.2. Metoden beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Underbilag 1.1 tager udgangspunkt i den metode, der bruges til NOVANA lysåben kontrolovervågning (beskrevet i den tekniske anvisning TA-N01 Overvågning af terrestriske naturtyper), suppleret med indsamling af ekstra data som fx registrering af arter i pinpoint og registrering af blomstring. Desuden afsættes punkterne med d-GPS.

description-proc.eng: The Danish Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation (DALO) is preparing the procurement of a comprehensive sensor and payload package for a Strategic Infrastructure Surveillance Vessel. DALO has acquired the offshore support vessel Norwind Helm, which will undergo conversion expectedly in Q4 2026 to fulfil its new operational role within the Royal Danish Navy. The conversion will include integration of advanced surveillance, and subsea capabilities. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued to engage with the market and obtain relevant information regarding: • Available technical solutions • Integration approaches • Commercial and contractual structures • Market capabilities and constraints • Delivery timelines and risk factors Participation in this RFI is voluntary. Non-participation will not affect eligibility in any future procurement. Procurement Intent DALO’s current preference is for a single prime contractor delivering a turnkey solution, including: • System design and architecture • Integration of sensors and payloads • Procurement of sensors and other equipment (ROV and AUVs) • Integration of existing onboard systems where applicable • Testing, validation and commissioning • Documentation and lifecycle support Alternative commercial models may be considered if clearly justified. Desired Supplier Profile Suppliers should demonstrate: • Supplier Facility Security Clearance level • Supplier Personnel Security Clearance level • Sensor- and payload-agnostic system architecture • Proven experience operating surface and subsea platforms • Proven delivery and use of sensor and payload package to allied navies. • End-to-end in-house capabilities (design, manufacturing, testing, simulation) • Operational delivery of seabed-to-space payload solutions • Training and maintenance • Demonstrated lifecycle cost efficiency Mission Definition & Multi-Mission Capability Solutions should support: • Critical Underwater Infrastructure (CUI) inspection • Mine Countermeasure (MCM) route inspection • Patrol and persistent presence operations • System architecture modularity and configurability. Operational Parameters Suppliers should demonstrate adaptability to: • Danish body of waters • Varying water depths and seabed conditions • Mission frequency and repetition cycles • Environmental protection and HSE requirements Sensor Deployment & Operations Describe: • On-vessel sensor deployment concepts • ROV/AUV launch and recovery systems • Containerised vs permanent installations • Hoist, overside, & moon-pool installation options. • Future integration of additional unmanned platforms Impact on Vessel Design Explain how payloads influence: • Stability and weight distribution • Power generation requirements • Battery safety management (AUV) • Data infrastructure and operator spaces Data Requirements Outline: • ROV/AUV navigational & sensor accuracy levels per mission type • Coverage rate and efficiency • Data density and resolution • Sampling capability where applicable Data Handling & Interoperability Provide details regarding: • Raw vs processed data outputs • Reporting and analytical products • Cloud infrastructure options • Interoperability with Royal Danish Navy systems • Access levels (onboard, remote, shore-based) Cybersecurity & Information Assurance Detail compliance with defence cybersecurity standards including: • Encryption protocols • Secure communications architecture • System hardening • Network segmentation • Data sovereignty compliance

title-proc.eng: Cityringen Extension Extension of existing transportation system

eng: The contract comprises the Transportation System ("TS") for the extension of Cityringen to Nordhavn. Metroselskabet ("MS") is constructing Cityringen in Copenhagen. Cityringen comprises 16 km tunnels, 17 underground stations and 4 shafts. MS is going to construct an extension to Nordhavnen (CRNHE). CRNHE is planned as an elevated line. The metro line will be crossing Skudeløbet in Nordhavn. The extension is expected to ready to open in 2030. The existing M4 line in Nordhavn is an attractive and function part of the network, but the CRNHE project aims to improve in terms of sustainability, passenger experience and operation. The transportation system contract for the Nordhavn Extension comprises all transportation systems and subsystems related to the extension, including Automatic Train Control (ATC), Passenger Security and Information System, Supervisory Control and Data (SCADA), Control Centre, Transmission Systems, and related fully integrated subsystems.

title-proc.eng: Delivery of Radiosonde Systems including related Services for Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI)

eng: The scope of this tender is to procure a framework agreement, which enables DMI to purchase radiosonde systems and related services over a four-year period. This agreement will enable DMI to conduct and collect upper-air meteorological measurements that provide inputs to numerical weather predictions and additionally are used for other purposes consistent with DMI’s general work scope and obligations as National Meteorological Service and contributor to international collaboration. The radiosonde measurements will be conducted from DMI’s manually operated radiosonde stations (four in Greenland and three established onboard ships sailing between Denmark and Greenland). The deliveries will consist of: I. Radiosonde instruments with measurement sensors (temperature, humidity and derived wind speed/direction and air pressure). II. Ground stations including all necessary hardware and software along with instructions and general documentation. III. Support and training of the DMI staff operating and servicing the radiosonde systems.
